w_text: Come one, come all.  Welcome to the Darkmoon Faire!  Don't be shy.  Step right up to Lhara and buy yourself an exotic artifact from far off lands. t_text: Today our world's destruction has been averted in defiance of our very makers!

w_text: Cold logic deemed our world not worth saving. Cold logic, however, does not account for the power of free will. It's up to each of us to prove this is a world worth saving.

w_text: Executor, your direct assault approach will cost us more lives than I am comfortable with. A more nuanced strategy is called for; one that involves us reclaiming the surrounding territory, starting with the villages so as to cut off all points of reinforcement to Deatholme.
t_text: Executor, your direct assault approach will cost us more lives than I am comfortable with. A more nuanced strategy is called for; one that involves us reclaiming the surrounding territory, starting with the villages so as to cut off all points of reinforcement to Deatholme.

w_text: I hear what you are saying, Mavren. Nevertheless, the final decision is mine. I appreciate your assistance, but the majority of the lives on the line are blood elf. I will not have those lives carelessly thrown away!
t_text: I hear what you are saying, Mavren. Nevertheless, the final decision is mine. I appreciate your assistance, but the majority of the lives on the line are blood elf. I will not have those lives carelessly thrown away!

w_text: How long until Forsaken reinforcements arrive? Our position here is tenuous. Your Lady promised us more soldiers. We must be able to concentrate solely on Deatholme and the Scourge!
t_text: How long until Forsaken reinforcements arrive? Our position here is tenuous. Your Lady promised us more soldiers. We must be able to concentrate solely on Deatholme and the Scourge!

w_text: Mavren, I don't want excuses, I want results! The Farstriders aren't available and we've received all that we're going to get from Silvermoon for now. I cannot ignore the Shadowpine trolls and Zul'Aman... they're arrayed across our eastern border!
t_text: Mavren, I don't want excuses, I want results! The Farstriders aren't available and we've received all that we're going to get from Silvermoon for now. I cannot ignore the Shadowpine trolls and Zul'Aman... they're arrayed across our eastern border!

w_text: No, I was right to begin with. Deatholme must come last. We must secure all of the Ghostlands first. I will not commit the forces here to a battle against Dar'khan with enemies to our flank and rear!
t_text: No, I was right to begin with. Deatholme must come last. We must secure all of the Ghostlands first. I will not commit the forces here to a battle against Dar'khan with enemies to our flank and rear!

w_text: Disagree with me all you like, High Executor. I will weigh your counsel, and then we will take the steps to free all of Quel'Thalas as I deem necessary. We shall continue this discussion anon.
t_text: Disagree with me all you like, High Executor. I will weigh your counsel, and then we will take the steps to free all of Quel'Thalas as I deem necessary. We shall continue this discussion anon.

w_text: Calm yourself, Idonis.  Brash actions will get us nowhere!  Take a break, tap into some mana crystals.  You'll feel better.
t_text: Calm yourself, Idonis.  Brash actions will get us nowhere!  Take a break, tap into some mana crystals.  You'll feel better.

w_text: He's got his reasons, Idonis.  He thinks the Farstriders have uncovered something.
t_text: He's got his reasons, Idonis.  He thinks the Farstriders have uncovered something.

w_text: We must remain focused on our work.  Once the sanctum starts producing at full capacity, Silvermoon will be forced to send help.  Functioning arcane sanctums are in short supply.
t_text: We must remain focused on our work.  Once the sanctum starts producing at full capacity, Silvermoon will be forced to send help.  Functioning arcane sanctums are in short supply.

t_text: %s turns to Advisor Valwyn and winks lasciviously in her direction.

w_text: With all due respect, milady, you have not fought the Scourge as I have. The Lady appointed me to assist you in defeating Dar'khan because of that, and you would do well to consider what I have to say.
t_text: With all due respect, milady, you have not fought the Scourge as I have. The Lady appointed me to assist you in defeating Dar'khan because of that, and you would do well to consider what I have to say.

w_text: I strongly disagree. Dar'khan is not going to get reinforcements because he'll be bottlenecked. Deatholme has only one way in and out. Your traitor was a fool to corner himself there, and I intend to exploit that weakness!
t_text: I strongly disagree. Dar'khan is not going to get reinforcements because he'll be bottlenecked. Deatholme has only one way in and out. Your traitor was a fool to corner himself there, and I intend to exploit that weakness!

w_text: This is war, Dame Auriferous, and in any war lives will be lost! The only areas that we need to secure are the two ziggurats. We will turtle in and take the Tower of the Damned and its master by brute force. Then you will have your Quel'Thalas.
t_text: This is war, Dame Auriferous, and in any war lives will be lost! The only areas that we need to secure are the two ziggurats. We will turtle in and take the Tower of the Damned and its master by brute force. Then you will have your Quel'Thalas.

w_text: And if your Farstriders were here to reinforce us, I might agree. But, they are busying themselves instead with the Shadowpine trolls on your eastern border. The longer we wait for them, the stronger the Scourge will become.
t_text: And if your Farstriders were here to reinforce us, I might agree. But, they are busying themselves instead with the Shadowpine trolls on your eastern border. The longer we wait for them, the stronger the Scourge will become.

w_text: I believe that you're making my argument for me, but yes it would be nice if we had more reinforcements. I would counter that it would be faster to pull the Farstriders from their senseless skirmishing with the trolls.
t_text: I believe that you're making my argument for me, but yes it would be nice if we had more reinforcements. I would counter that it would be faster to pull the Farstriders from their senseless skirmishing with the trolls.

w_text: Dame Auriferous, we are the reinforcements. It may come to pass that The Lady will send more men in time. Better that you convince Silvermoon City to muster all of its forces and put them at our disposal here.
t_text: Dame Auriferous, we are the reinforcements. It may come to pass that The Lady will send more men in time. Better that you convince Silvermoon City to muster all of its forces and put them at our disposal here.

w_text: You are correct; we must concentrate on the Scourge. Ignore the trolls and the villages, and focus our attentions on Deatholme! With Dar'khan defeated you will find that the rest of the Scourge 'body' will fall quickly, lacking their 'head'.
t_text: You are correct; we must concentrate on the Scourge. Ignore the trolls and the villages, and focus our attentions on Deatholme! With Dar'khan defeated you will find that the rest of the Scourge 'body' will fall quickly, lacking their 'head'.

w_text: Forsaken reinforcements? Undercity is stretched thin with the Scourge on all sides. No, this will be a matter largely dealt with by the blood elves. We Forsaken are here as backup and advisors.
t_text: Forsaken reinforcements? Undercity is stretched thin with the Scourge on all sides. No, this will be a matter largely dealt with by the blood elves. We Forsaken are here as backup and advisors.

w_text: Again I strongly disagree with your view of the strategic situation. Your plan will spread our forces too thin. It will leave us with only a small force to assault Deatholme. I cannot in good conscience execute such a strategy.
t_text: Again I strongly disagree with your view of the strategic situation. Your plan will spread our forces too thin. It will leave us with only a small force to assault Deatholme. I cannot in good conscience execute such a strategy.

w_text: Spread throughout the Ghostlands, our forces will be of little use in an assault on Deatholme. No, milady, I am here to kill Dar'khan and that is what I intend to do!
t_text: Spread throughout the Ghostlands, our forces will be of little use in an assault on Deatholme. No, milady, I am here to kill Dar'khan and that is what I intend to do!

w_text: We've been over this before. Only a focused assault upon Deatholme will meet with success. These other targets are distractions that we can ill afford. I suggest that you inform your Captain Helios that he is to leave off his campaign against the Shadowpine trolls and focus solely on the Scourge.
t_text: We've been over this before. Only a focused assault upon Deatholme will meet with success. These other targets are distractions that we can ill afford. w_text: Blessed Light! She's siphoning energy right out of the Vector Coil!
t_text: Blessed Light! She's siphoning energy right out of the Vector Coil!

w_text: Cover me, we have to do this quickly. Once I blow the support on this side, it will disrupt the energy beams and she'll break out! I doubt very much that she'll be happy to see us.
t_text: Cover me, we have to do this quickly. Once I blow the support on this side, it will disrupt the energy beams and she'll break out! I doubt very much that she'll be happy to see us.

w_text: I've almost got it! Just a little more time...
t_text: I've almost got it! Just a little more time...

w_text: Take cover and be ready for the fight of your life, $n!
t_text: Take cover and be ready for the fight of your life!

w_text: Holy mother of O'ros!
t_text: Holy mother of O'ros!

w_text: I... I can't believe it's over. You did it! You've destroyed the blood elves and their leader!
t_text: I... I can't believe it's over. You did it! You've destoyed the blood elves and their leader!

w_text: Get back to Blood Watch. I'll see you there...
t_text: Get back to Blood Watch. I'll see you there...

w_text: Help! Someone help us!
t_text: Help! Someone help us!

w_text: Get out of here, there are too many of them! Escape while you can!
t_text: Get out of here, there are too many of them! Escape while you can!

w_text: You won't escape us, druid!
t_text: You won't escape us, druid!

w_text: %s becomes enraged!
t_text: %s becomes enraged!

w_text: We are honored by your presence, son of Durotan. The Greatmother awaits you at the hospice.
t_text: We are honored by your presence, son of Durotan. The Greatmother awaits you at the hospice.

w_text: %s points towards the hospice.
t_text: %s points towards the hospice.

w_text: As you wish, Thrall, son of Durotan.
t_text: As you wish, Thrall, son of Durotan.

w_text: %s collapses.
t_text: %s collapses.

w_text: For my entire life I have thought my bloodline cursed. I have lived beneath the shadow of my father's greatest failure.
t_text: For my entire life I have thought my bloodline cursed. I have lived beneath the shadow of my father's greatest failure.

w_text: I hated him for what he had done. I hated him for the burden he left me. But now...
t_text: I hated him for what he had done. I hated him for the burden he left me. But now...

w_text: You have shown me truths that I would have never known. You and your allies have gifted me with something that cannot bear a price: Redemption. Thrall, redeemer of the Mag'har, you honor me as none ever have...
t_text: You have shown me truths that I would have never known. You and your allies have gifted me with something that cannot bear a price: Redemption. Thrall, redeemer of the Mag'har, you honor me as none ever have...

w_text: On this day, a great burden has been lifted from my chest. My heart swells with pride. And for the first time, I can proudly proclaim who I am. I can finally unleash the fury in my heart.
t_text: On this day, a great burden has been lifted from my chest. My heart swells with pride. And for the first time, I can proudly proclaim who I am. I can finally unleash the fury in my heart.

w_text: I am Garrosh Hellscream, son of Grom, chieftain of the Mag'har! Let the battle call of Hellscream give you courage and strength! Be lifted by my rallying cry.
t_text: I am Garrosh Hellscream, son of Grom, chieftain of the Mag'har! Let the battle call of Hellscream give you courage and strength! Be lifted by my rallying cry.

w_text: Thank you, son of Durotan.
t_text: Thank you, son of Durotan.

w_text: Dat was poop! Mogor could put up much better fight den dat!
t_text: Dat was poop! Mogor could put up much better fight den dat!

w_text: Mogor not impressed! Skra'gath wuz made of da air and shadow! Soft like da squishy orcies!
t_text: Mogor not impressed! Skra'gath wuz made of da air and shadow! Soft like da squishy orcies!

w_text: Now you face da true champion! I give you chance to run away little one. Run away now before Mogor decim... destyor... Run away before Mogor KILL!
t_text: Now you face da true champion! I give you chance to run away little one. Run away now before Mogor decim... destyor... Run away before Mogor KILL!

w_text: No more chances! Now you pay da ogre!
t_text: No more chances! Now you pay da ogre!

w_text: No more nice ogre! You hurt Mogor!!
t_text: No more nice ogre! You hurt Mogor!!

w_text: WUT!? UNPOSSIBLE!! You fight Mogor now! Mogor destroy!
t_text: WUT!? UNPOSSIBLE!! You fight Mogor now! Mogor destroy!

w_text: %s laughs.
t_text: %s laughs.

w_text: So predictable. I knew you would come. And I see you've brought the mighty Hellscream.
t_text: So predictable. I knew you would come. And I see you've brought the mighty Hellscream.

w_text: His blood is mine, as is your whole misbegotten race.
t_text: His blood is mine, as is your whole misbegotten race.

w_text: A worthy effort, but futile.
t_text: A worthy effort, but futile.

w_text: %s laughs.
t_text: %s laughs.

w_text: The boy believed you could be saved, but he didn't know what burns within your soul when in your heart, you know we are the same.
t_text: The boy believed you could be saved, but he didn't know what burns within your soul when in your heart, you know we are the same.

w_text: NOOOO!
t_text: NOOOO!

w_text: Thrall... The blood haze has lifted.
t_text: Thrall... The blood haze has lifted.

w_text: Grom's eyes go dim as the blood curse is lifted.
t_text: Grom's eyes go dim as the blood curse is lifted.

w_text: The demon's fire has burnt out in my veins. I have... freed myself.
t_text: The demon's fire has burnt out in my veins. I have... freed myself.

w_text: Thrall! Come outside and face your fate!
t_text: Thrall! Come outside and face your fate!

w_text: Taretha's life hangs in the balance. Surely you care for her. Surely you wish to save her...
t_text: Taretha's life hangs in the balance. Surely you care for her. Surely you wish to save her...

w_text: Ah, there you are. I had hoped to accomplish this with a bit of subtlety, but I suppose direct confrontation was inevitable. Your future, Thrall, must not come to pass and so... you and your troublesome friends must die!
t_text: Ah, there you are. I had hoped to accomplish this with a bit of subtlety, but I suppose direct confrontation was inevitable. Your future, Thrall, must not come to pass and so... you and your troublesome friends must die!

w_text: Enough, I will erase your very existence!
t_text: Enough, I will erase your very existence!

w_text: You cannot fight fate!
t_text: You cannot fight fate!

w_text: You are... irrelevant.
t_text: You are... irrelevant.

w_text: Thrall will remain a slave. Taretha will die. You have failed.
t_text: Thrall will remain a slave. Taretha will die. You have failed.

w_text: Not so fast!
t_text: Not so fast!

w_text: Struggle as much as you like...
t_text: Struggle as much as you like...

w_text: No! The master will... not be... pleased.
t_text: No! The master will... not be... pleased.

w_text: %s examines the information on the wanted poster.
t_text: %s examines the information on the wanted poster.

w_text: Obey the laws of Silvermoon. Failure to do so will result in termination.
t_text: Obey the laws of Silvermoon. Failure to do so will result in termination.

w_text: Maintain order within these walls.
t_text: Maintain order within these walls.

w_text: Happiness is mandatory, citizen.
t_text: Happiness is mandatory, citizen.

w_text: Remain strong. Kael'thas will - error - Lor'themar will lead you to power and glory!
t_text: Remain strong. Kael'thas will - error - Lor'themar will lead you to power and glory!

w_text: Do not disturb the serenity of the city. Peace must be upheld.
t_text: Do not disturb the serenity of the city. Peace must be upheld.

w_text: %s becomes enraged!
t_text: %s becomes enraged!

w_text: Burn! Burn! Burn!
t_text: Burn! Burn! Burn!

w_text: %s becomes enraged!
t_text: %s becomes enraged!

w_text: You no take mushroom!
t_text: You no take mushroom!

w_text: %s becomes enraged!
t_text: %s becomes enraged!

w_text: I have been expecting you, young one. Come closer - my eyes are not as sharp as they once were.
t_text: I have been expecting you, young one. Come closer - my eyes are not as sharp as they once were.

w_text: Yes, you move like my son. You have his broad shoulders - ahh, and your mother's fierce eyes.
t_text: Yes, you move like my son. You have his broad shoulders - ahh, and your mother's fierce eyes.

w_text: There is no doubt - you are the heir of Durotan... my grandson. Draka told me she was with child before she and your father left our world, but I never dared dream that they would survive...
t_text: There is no doubt - you are the heir of Durotan... my grandson. Draka told me she was with child before she and your father left our world, but I never dared dream that they would survive...

w_text: Thrall? You've been a slave only to the past, grandson! But no more! When last I saw him, Durotan told me the name he would give his unborn son... He was... so proud...
t_text: Thrall? You've been a slave only to the past, grandson! But no more! When last I saw him, Durotan told me the name he would give his unborn son... He was... so proud...

w_text: %s wipes a tear away.
t_text: %s wipes a tear away.

w_text: Go'el. You are Go'el, son of Durotan - rightful chieftain of the Frostwolves. This day, grandson - you are the great joy of my heart.
t_text: Go'el. You are Go'el, son of Durotan - rightful chieftain of the Frostwolves. This day, grandson - you are the great joy of my heart.

w_text: I see that you hold the Doomhammer. Have all of our greatest heroes fallen, grandson?
t_text: I see that you hold the Doomhammer. Have all of our greatest heroes fallen, grandson?

w_text: What of Grommash? What of Hellscream?
t_text: What of Grommash? What of Hellscream?

w_text: Blessed spirits! For twenty years, all we knew was that Grom was the first to drink from the cursed chalice and bring damnation down upon our people... It is the only truth his son, Garrosh has ever known.
t_text: Blessed spirits! For twenty years, all we knew was that Grom was the first to drink from the cursed chalice and bring damnation down upon our people... It is the only truth his son, Garrosh has ever known.

w_text: Grandson, will you... Will you tell Garrosh what you have told me about his father?
t_text: Grandson, will you... Will you tell Garrosh what you have told me about his father?

w_text: %s inclines his head slightly to the pair of guardians in greeting.
t_text: %s inclines his head slightly to the pair of guardians in greeting.

w_text: %s arches a sculpted brow at the guards, a disapproving scowl on his face.
t_text: %s arches a sculpted brow at the guards, a disapproving scowl on his face.

w_text: %s glances from guard to guard.
t_text: %s glances from guard to guard.

w_text: %s surveys the small ranger practice ground with a condescending smirk.
t_text: %s surveys the small ranger practice ground with a condescending smirk.

w_text: Do not burden A'dal with mundane questions, $r.  This being's will is all that keeps our enemies from crushing this city.
t_text: Do not burden A'dal with mundane questions, $r.  This being's will is all that keeps our enemies from crushing this city.

w_text: Show our guest around Shattrath, will you?  Keep an eye out for pickpockets in the Lower City.
t_text: Show our guest around Shattrath, will you?  Keep an eye out for pickpockets in the Lower City.

w_text: Woe to each and every one of you, my pretties!
t_text: Woe to each and every one of you, my pretties!

w_text: It will all be over soon!
t_text: It will all be over soon!

w_text: How could you? What a cruel, cruel world...
t_text: How could you? What a cruel, cruel world...

w_text: Fixed you, didn't I?
t_text: Fixed you, didn't I?

w_text: Lady Liadrin is bound to find a way. She must.
t_text: Lady Liadrin is bound to find a way. She must.

w_text: Is... it true, what I've heard?  That it was the Sun King himself?
t_text: Is... it true, what I've heard?  That it was the Sun King himself?

w_text: Still, the Blood Knights will endure through this loss. We have no other choice... we must find another source.
t_text: Still, the Blood Knights will endure through this loss. We have no other choice... we must find another source.

w_text: Who do they think they are?
t_text: Who do they think they are?

w_text: I know what you mean... they whisper about us when they think we can't hear them. They'll get theirs.
t_text: I know what you mean... they whisper about us when they think we can't hear them. They'll get theirs.

w_text: Jealous, that's what they are. They're afraid to dedicate themselves to true power.
t_text: Jealous, that's what they are. They're afraid to dedicate themselves to true power.

w_text: They simply fear what they cannot begin to understand.
t_text: They simply fear what they cannot begin to understand.

w_text: Matters are so uncertain now that the chamber below is empty...
t_text: Matters are so uncertain now that the chamber below is empty...

w_text: It's gone. I can't believe it's gone. Who would have thought we'd be betrayed like this?
t_text: It's gone. I can't believe it's gone. Who would have thought we'd be betrayed like this?

w_text: Our neighbors are positively laughable. Have you seen the way they turn up their noses at us?
t_text: Our neighbors are positively laughable. Have you seen the way they turn up their noses at us?

w_text: The rangers certainly have a high opinion of themselves.
t_text: The rangers certainly have a high opinion of themselves.

w_text: I'm quickly tiring of the haughty attitude I receive from those grubby bowslingers outside.
t_text: I'm quickly tiring of the haughty attitude I receive from those grubby bowslingers outside.

w_text: Uh oh. Those stags don't look pleased with us!
t_text: Uh oh, those stags don't look pleased with us!

w_text: Look out, Fitz! They're coming right for us!
t_text: Look out, Fitz, they're coming right for us!

w_text: If your people are as strong as you purport, I'm sure you'll find your stride again.
t_text: If your people are as strong as you purport, I'm sure you'll find your stride again.

w_text: %s taps a finger on her chin, lost in thought.
t_text: %s taps a finger on her chin, lost in thought.

w_text: I suppose we'll see the measure of your dedication in due time.
t_text: I suppose we'll see the measure of your dedication in due time.

w_text: I don't suppose Lor'themar Theron is available for an audience yet?
t_text: I don't suppose Lor'themar Theron is available for an audience yet?

w_text: I'll accept that answer for the time being, Kelemar, but my patience is not exactly boundless.
t_text: I'll accept that answer for the time being, Kelemar, but my patience is not exactly boundless.

w_text: Remind me, ambassador... what precisely will your people be contributing to our efforts?
t_text: Remind me, ambassador... what precisely will your people be contributing to our efforts?

w_text: You should be used to those looks, Tatai. Do you remember the reason you were drafted into this job?
t_text: You should be used to those looks, Tatai. Do you remember the reason you were drafted into this job?

w_text: I'm no happier about being your babysitter than you are about being watched. Just remember... it could have been worse.
t_text: I'm no happier about being your babysitter than you are about being watched. Just remember... it could have been worse.

w_text: Well, no one asked you, Tatai.
t_text: Well, no one asked you, Tatai.

w_text: Tatai!
t_text: Tatai!

w_text: Bah! If I ever be in charge'a dis place, da first t'ing I be doin' is stoppin' alla dat. Ja be markin' my words.
t_text: Bah! If I ever be in charge'a dis place, da first t'ing I be doin' is stoppin' alla dat. Ja be markin' my words.

w_text: Dis place be huge. Why ja be needin' all dis space?
t_text: Dis place be huge. Why ja be needin' all dis space?

w_text: Why be all dese t'ings floatin' an' movin' by demselves?
t_text: Why be all dese t'ings floatin' an' movin' by demselves?

w_text: Dis place be too bright fa my tastes.
t_text: Dis place be too bright fa my tastes.

w_text: What help be ja givin' de Horde, anyway?
t_text: What help be ja givin' de Horde, anyway?

w_text: Just what I be t'inkin'. More delays.
t_text: Just what I be t'inkin'. More delays.

w_text: Ja be keepin' away from me.
t_text: Ja be keepin' away from me.

w_text: I be gettin' tired'a dis. Dese elves, dey be treatin' me like I stole somet'in'.
t_text: I be gettin' tired'a dis. Dese elves, dey be treatin' me like I stole somet'in'.

w_text: Don't ja start...
t_text: Don't ja start...

w_text: Dis be a big waste, if ja be askin' me.
t_text: Dis be a big waste, if ja be askin' me.

w_text: %s grumbles under his breath.
t_text: %s grumbles under his breath.

w_text: T'ink ja be contributin' less glarin' in dis troll's direction?
t_text: T'ink ja be contributin' less glarin' in dis troll's direction?

w_text: %s sighs in resignation and falls silent.
t_text: %s sighs in resignation and falls silent.

w_text: This city is very... expansive, but it seems to be lacking something. I can't put my finger on what...
t_text: This city is very... expansive, but it seems to be lacking something. I can't put my finger on what...

w_text: It seems that a great deal of your power is used for... and I hope you'll pardon the term... frivolous things. Isn't that, well, wasteful?
t_text: It seems that a great deal of your power is used for... and I hope you'll pardon the term... frivolous things. Isn't that, well, wasteful?

w_text: Tatai, please. We're guests here.
t_text: Tatai, please. We're guests here.

w_text: There's an ethereal beauty about this place... but for all the trees and plant life, it's still so... unnatural.
t_text: There's an ethereal beauty about this place... but for all the trees and plant life, it's still so... unnatural.

w_text: As you say, ambassador. We can wait.
t_text: As you say, ambassador. We can wait.

w_text: Tell us, Ambassador Kelemar... how do the blood elves plan to aid us, exactly?
t_text: Tell us, Ambassador Kelemar... how do the blood elves plan to aid us, exactly?

w_text: Dela Runetotem's brow furrows, but she remains silent.
t_text: Dela Runetotem's brow furrows, but she remains silent.

w_text: My condolences. These past years have been hard on us all.
t_text: My condolences. These past years have been hard on us all.

w_text: I don't know. It still seems like such a waste.
t_text: I don't know. It still seems like such a waste.

w_text: You're not the only victims of the Scourge. Our lady Sylvanas sympathizes with your plight.
t_text: You're not the only victims of the Scourge. Our lady Sylvanas sympathizes with your plight.

w_text: Your choice of decor is intriguing, Kelemar. Tell me - why the arcane frippery?
t_text: Your choice of decor is intriguing, Kelemar. Tell me - why the arcane frippery?

w_text: An understandable expenditure, as I see it. Show everyone, enemies and allies alike, that you're not afraid to use your power.
t_text: An understandable expenditure, as I see it. Show everyone, enemies and allies alike, that you're not afraid to use your power.

w_text: Such marvelous sights. I regret being unable to see it when I was younger.
t_text: Such marvelous sights. I regret being unable to see it when I was younger.

w_text: Truly an advantageous alliance.
t_text: Truly an advantageous alliance.

w_text: I thought we were going to speak with the regent lord. I'm beginning to question whether or not he exists at all at this point.
t_text: I thought we were going to speak with the regent lord. I'm beginning to question whether or not he exists at all at this point.

w_text: This is becoming tiresome.
t_text: This is becoming tiresome.

w_text: Troll, if you can't keep a civil tongue in your head, I'll be happy to remove it for you.
t_text: Troll, if you can't keep a civil tongue in your head, I'll be happy to remove it for you.

w_text: %s smirks triumphantly.
t_text: %s smirks triumphantly.

w_text: This is merely part of what Silvermoon once was. Much of the city was lost after Arthas swept through our lands.
t_text: This is merely part of what Silvermoon once was. Much of the city was lost after Arthas swept through our lands.

w_text: We lost many of our kin in the war... so yes, the city is not perhaps as lively as it once was. We will endure, however.
t_text: We lost many of our kin in the war... so yes, the city is not perhaps as lively as it once was. We will endure, however.

w_text: It is not simply a beautification measure, but also a morale booster. It demonstrates to our people that we have a great deal of power at our fingertips, and with it... we can do nearly anything.
t_text: It is not simply a beautification measure, but also a morale booster. It demonstrates to our people that we have a great deal of power at our fingertips, and with it... we can do nearly anything.

w_text: Think about it carefully, my friends. If we can afford to spend our magic on simple aesthetic enhancements, clearly we hold a vast reservoir of power at our beck and call.
t_text: Think about it carefully, my friends. If we can afford to spend our magic on simple aesthetic enhancements, clearly we hold a vast reservoir of power at our beck and call.

w_text: This must be somewhat different from the environment to which you're accustomed. It is a visible demonstration of the power we hold, nothing more. We're mindful of our resources.
t_text: This must be somewhat different from the environment to which you're accustomed. It is a visible demonstration of the power we hold, nothing more. We're mindful of our resources.

w_text: Yes, well... luckily for us all, the troll will not be in a position of power within our fair city anytime soon.
t_text: Yes, well... luckily for us all, the troll will not be in a position of power within our fair city anytime soon.

w_text: The regent lord is a very busy man. I'm sure you understand.
t_text: The regent lord is a very busy man. I'm sure you understand.

w_text: He is unable to see you just yet, but do not trouble yourselves over it. I'm certain he will find a way to fit you into his busy schedule.
t_text: He is unable to see you just yet, but do not trouble yourselves over it. I'm certain he will find a way to fit you into his busy schedule.

w_text: In due course. There is no rush, after all - our hospitality is extended to you indefinitely. Even the troll.
t_text: In due course. There is no rush, after all - our hospitality is extended to you indefinitely. Even the troll.

w_text: Exercise caution during your stay. Some close-minded individuals may still cling to old alliances long since dissolved...
t_text: Exercise caution during your stay. Some close-minded individuals may still cling to old alliances long since dissolved...

w_text: Thank you for making the journey here. I hope you will find Silvermoon to your liking.
t_text: Thank you for making the journey here. I hope you will find Silvermoon to your liking.

w_text: Behold the wonders of our fair city.
t_text: Behold the wonders of our fair city.

w_text: Our people are strong. We bring you a mastery over arcane magics that you have previously lacked - ah, no offense intended, of course.
t_text: Our people are strong. We bring you a mastery over arcane magics that you have previously lacked - ah, no offense intended, of course.

w_text: Surely you see the advantage in our relationship. The powers we command are immense. With our aid, your enemies could well be decimated.
t_text: Surely you see the advantage in our relationship. The powers we command are immense. With our aid, your enemies could well be decimated.

w_text: I realize we have had somewhat differing loyalties in the past, but put your suspicions aside. Our considerable power has been pledged to your leaders in good faith.
t_text: I realize we have had somewhat differing loyalties in the past, but put your suspicions aside. Our considerable power has been pledged to your leaders in good faith.

w_text: I'm afraid your ancestry is the cause, troll. Decades of fighting with your green-skinned brethren have hardened their hearts against your kind.
t_text: I'm afraid your ancestry is the cause, troll. Decades of fighting with your green-skinned brethren have hardened their hearts against your kind.

w_text: Keep your chin up. Perhaps with time, our people will see you as the ally you are, rather than the enemy you appear to be.
t_text: Keep your chin up. Perhaps with time, our people will see you as the ally you are, rather than the enemy you appear to be.

w_text: %s smiles and sheathes his rifle.
t_text: %s smiles and sheathes his rifle.

w_text: Where do you think you're going? Kill them all!
t_text: Where do you think you're going? Kill them all!

w_text: Will the pain ever end?
t_text: Will the pain ever end?

w_text: Help me!  Please help me!
t_text: Help me!  Please help me!

w_text: How can you just leave me here?
t_text: How can you just leave me here?

w_text: Look out!
t_text: Look out!

w_text: Don't let them escape! Kill the strong one first!
t_text: Don't let them escape! Kill the strong one first!

w_text: More of them coming! Watch out!
t_text: More of them coming! Watch out!

w_text: Where do you think you're going? Kill them all!
t_text: Where do you think you're going? Kill them all!

w_text: Ride the lightning, filth!
t_text: Ride the lightning, filth!

w_text: FROST SHOCK!
t_text: FROST SHOCK!

w_text: Up ahead is the road to Telaar. We will split up when we reach the fork as they will surely send more Murkblood after us. Hopefully one of us makes it back to Telaar alive.
t_text: Up ahead is the road to Telaar. We will split up when we reach the fork as they will surely send more Murkblood after us. Hopefully one of us makes it back to Telaar alive.

w_text: Look out!
t_text: Look out!

w_text: More of them coming! Watch out!
t_text: More of them coming! Watch out!

w_text: Ride the lightning, filth!
t_text: Ride the lightning, filth!

w_text: FROST SHOCK!
t_text: FROST SHOCK!

w_text: It is best that we split up now, in case they send more after us. Hopefully one of us will make it back to Garrosh. Farewell, stranger.
t_text: It is best that we split up now, in case they send more after us. Hopefully one of us will make it back to Garrosh. Farewell, stranger.

w_text: Don't let them escape! Kill the strong one first!
t_text: Don't let them escape! Kill the strong one first!

w_text: Uh... sure thing, Gankly.  Just...<cough>... wait right there.  <Cough>  Guys?
t_text: Uh... sure thing, Gankly.  Just...<cough>... wait right there.  <Cough>  Guys?

w_text: What's going on?!
t_text: What's going on?!

w_text: Um... guys?
t_text: Um... guys?

w_text: Hemet?  Fitz?

t_text: ...that it is a gift, given freely to all naturally born beings.

w_text: It manifests itself as a feeling, small at first and easily ignored, that confirms truths and subtly prods one to do good.
t_text: It manifests itself as a feeling, small at first and easily ignored, that confirms truths and subtly prods one to do good.

w_text: Simple kindnesses, charitable deeds, service to those in need. These are all fruits of the Light.

w_text: It rewards those who heed its promptings with blessings, both seen and unseen.
t_text: It rewards those who heed its promptings with blessings, both seen and unseen.

t_text: Personal reservoirs of hope and faith are strengthened, and one's capacity for greater light increases.

t_text: Over the course of time, through obedience to the Light's guidance, one becomes more sensitive to its voice, and its power.

w_text: Great is the healing and blessing power of the Light's most diligent followers.

w_text: Sadly, there are those who wander through mortality in defiance of the Light.
t_text: Sadly, there are those who wander through mortality in defiance of the Light.

w_text: From these the Light withdraws, until only darkness remains.
t_text: From these the Light withdraws, until only darkness remains.

w_text: As custodians of time, we watch over and care for Nozdormu's realm. The master is away at the moment, which means that attempts are being made to dramatically alter time. The master never meddles in the affairs of mortals but instead corrects the alterations made to time by others. He is reactionary in this regard.

w_text: For normal maintenance of time, the Keepers of Time are sufficient caretakers. We are able to deal with most ordinary disturbances. I speak of little things, such as rogue mages changing something in the past to elevate their status or wealth in the present.

w_text: These tunnels that you see are called timeways. They are infinite in number. The ones that currently exist in your reality are what the master has deemed as 'trouble spots.' w_text: Who dares slay one of my Kargath's commanders?  You will pay for this... in flesh!

w_text: Let us leave this place.  I've had enough of these madmen!

w_text: Beware!  More cultists come!

w_text: I can find my way from here.  My friend Mekeda will reward you for your kind actions.

w_text: Speak, filthy refugee!  What was your caravan doing in the Bone Wastes?
t_text: Speak, filthy refugee!  What was your caravan doing in the Bone Wastes?

w_text: Incompetent fools!  Auchindoun should've been ours... look at yourselves scrambling like rats!
t_text: Incompetent fools!  Auchindoun should've been ours... look at yourselves scrambling like rats!

w_text: Me smash! You die!
t_text: Me smash! You die!

w_text: Raaar!!! Me smash $r!
t_text: Raaar!!! Me smash $r!

w_text: I'll crush you!
t_text: I'll crush you!

t_text: Puny $r... you were a... horrible $g king : queen;.

w_text: Agh... me am...dead.

w_text: Me go to... Ogri'la.
t_text: Me go to... Ogri'la.

t_text: $G King : Queen; think... there really is... an Ogri'la?

w_text: Me honored... $g king : queen; kill me.
t_text: Me honored... $g king : queen; kill me.

t_text: $G King : Queen; $n, me die now.

t_text: %s squawks and heads toward Veil Shalas. Hurry and follow!

t_text: %s bellows a loud squawk!

w_text: Free at last from that horrible curse! Thank you! Please send word to Rilak the Redeemed that I am okay. My mission lies in Skettis. Terokk must be defeated!
t_text: Free at last from that horrible curse! Thank you! Please send word to Rilak the Redeemed that I am okay. My mission lies in Skettis. Terokk must be defeated!

w_text: It is time.  The rite of exorcism will now commence...

w_text: Prepare yourself.  Do not allow the ritual to be interrupted or we may lose our patient...
t_text: Prepare yourself. Do not allow the ritual to be interrupted or we may lose our patient...

w_text: Back, foul beings of darkness!  You have no power here!
t_text: Back foul beings of darkness! You have no power here!

w_text: I... must not...falter!
t_text: I... must not... falter

w_text: The Light is my guide... it is my sustenance!
t_text: The Light is my guide... it is my sustenance!

w_text: The power of Light compels you!  Back to your pit!
t_text: The power of light compells you! Back to your pit!

w_text: Be cleansed with Light, human!  Let not the demonic corruption overwhelm you.
t_text: Be cleansed with Light, human! Let not the demonic corruption overwhelm you.

w_text: Back!  I cast you back... corrupter of faith!  Author of pain!  Do not return, or suffer the same fate as you did here today!
t_text: Back! I cast you back... corruptor of faith! Author of pain! Do not return, or suffer the same fate as you did here today!

w_text: Keep away. The fool is mine.
t_text: Keep away. The fool is mine.

w_text: Ah!  Cease the incantations, Anchorite!  Cease, or I will show you such pain that your pathetic people have never imagined!
t_text: Ah! Cease the incantations, Anchorite! Cease, or I will show you such pain that your pathetic people have never imagined!

w_text: This is fruitless, draenei!  You and your little helper cannot wrest control of this pathetic human.  He is mine!
t_text: This is fruitless, draenei! You and your little helper cannot wrest control of this pathetic human. He is mine!

w_text: I see your ancestors, Anchorite!  They writhe and scream in the darkness... they are with us!
t_text: I see your ancestors, Anchorite! They writhe and scream in the darkness... they are with us!

w_text: I will tear your soul into morsels and slow roast them over demon fire!
t_text: I will tear your soul into morsels and slow roast them over demon fire.

w_text: I am Rexxar, son of the Mok'Nathal, champion of the Horde.
t_text: I am Rexxar, son of the Mok'Nathal, champion of the Horde.

w_text: And their torment at your hands is at an end. By my name, I shall put an end to your life.
t_text: And their torment at your hands is at an end. By my name, I shall put an end to your life.

w_text: Prepare yourself for the end.
t_text: Prepare yourself for the end.

w_text: I could not have achieved this victory without you. We will speak back at Thunderlord Stronghold.
t_text: I could not have achieved this victory without you. We will speak back at Thunderlord Stronghold.

w_text: You have brought me back too soon! I am weak yet... What is this! Who... It matters not! DIE!
t_text: You have brought me back too soon! I am weak yet... What is this! Who... It matters not! DIE!

w_text: Vengeance will not be yours, $n!
t_text: Vengeance will not be yours, $n!

w_text: Aright, listen up! Form a circle around me and move out!
t_text: Aright, listen up! Form a circle around me and move out!

w_text: Aright, $r, just keep us safe from harm while we work. We'll pay you when we return.
t_text: Aright, $r, just keep us safe from harm while we work. We'll pay you when we return.

w_text: The dig site is just north of here.
t_text: The dig site is just north of here.

w_text: We're here! Start diggin'!
t_text: We're here! Start diggin'!

w_text: I think there's somethin' buried here, beneath the sand!
t_text: I think there's somethin' buried here, beneath the sand!

w_text: Almost got it!
t_text: Almost got it!

w_text: By Brann's brittle bananas! What is it!? It... It looks like a drum.
t_text: By Brann's brittle bananas! What is it!? It... It looks like a drum.

w_text: Have ye gone mad? You expect me to leave behind a drum without first beatin' on it? Not this son of Ironforge! No sir!
t_text: Have ye gone mad? You expect me to leave behind a drum without first beatin' on it? Not this son of Ironforge! No sir!

w_text: Shut yer yaps! I'm gonna bang on this drum and that's that!
t_text: Shut yer yaps! I'm gonna bang on this drum and that's that!

w_text: IN YOUR FACE! I told you there was somethin' here!
t_text: IN YOUR FACE! I told you there was somethin' here!

w_text: Don't just stand there! Help $g him:her; out!
t_text: Don't just stand there! Help $g him:her; out!

w_text: You've been a tremendous help, $r! Let's get out of here before more of those things show up! I'll let Dwarfowitz know you did the job asked of ya' admirably.
t_text: You've been a tremendous help, $r! Let's get out of here before more of those things show up! I'll let Dwarfowitz know you did the job asked of ya' admirably.

w_text: Praise the naaru, I'm saved.  I will try to make it clear on my own.
t_text: Praise the naaru, I'm saved. I will try to make it clear on my own.

w_text: I'm hurt, but I can still run.  Thank you, stranger.
t_text: I'm hurt, but I can still run. Thank you, stranger.

w_text: My thanks, stranger.
t_text: My thanks, stranger.

w_text: I'm too weak to fight with you.  Please find my friends.
t_text: I'm too weak to fight with you.  Please find my friends.

w_text: Wow... a drum.
t_text: Wow... a drum.

w_text: This discovery will surely rock the foundation of modern archaeology.
t_text: This discovery will surely rock the foundation of modern archaeology.

w_text: Yea, great. Can we leave now? This desert is giving me hives.
t_text: Yea, great. Can we leave now? This desert is giving me hives.

w_text: This reminds me of that one time where you made us search Silithus for evidence of sand gnomes.
t_text: This reminds me of that one time where you made us search Silithus for evidence of sand gnomes.

w_text: Or that time when you told us that you'd discovered the cure for the plague of the 20th century. What is that even? 20th century?
t_text: Or that time when you told us that you'd discovered the cure for the plague of the 20th century. What is that even? 20th century?

w_text: I don't think it can top the one time where he told us that he'd heard that Arthas's "cousin's" skeleton was frozen beneath a glacier in Winterspring. I'll never forgive you for that one, Letoll. I mean honestly... Arthas's cousin?
t_text: I don't think it can top the one time where he told us that he'd heard that Arthas's "cousin's" skeleton was frozen beneath a glacier in Winterspring. I'll never forgive you for that one, Letoll. I mean honestly... Arthas's cousin?

w_text: I dunno. It can't possibly beat the time he tried to convince us that we're all actually a figment of some being's imagination and that they only use us for their own personal amusement. That went over well during dinner with the family.
t_text: I dunno. It can't possibly beat the time he tried to convince us that we're all actually a figment of some being's imagination and that they only use us for their own personal amusement. That went over well during dinner with the family.

t_text: Say, do you guys hear that?

w_text: I'm only 4 years old.
t_text: I'm only 4 years old.

w_text: Have you seen my mommy and daddy?
t_text: Have you seen my mommy and daddy?

w_text: Antelarion, is it safe to play in the forest yet?
t_text: Antelarion, is it safe to play in the forest yet?

w_text: I think I came from Eng-land, do you know where that is?
t_text: I think I came from Eng-land, do you know where that is?

t_text: Antelarion says I fell off a big bird, as I fell he caught me... He is so pretty!

w_text: It's only right that you know the name of the one who will take your life.
t_text: It's only right that you know the name of the one who will take your life.

t_text: Baron Sablemane. It will be on your lips as you gasp your dying breath.

t_text: Let us begin.

t_text: We will speak again, but away from here.

w_text: Akama, my friend!  Have you been informed?  I was found out by Vashj's followers.  Our secret is in peril!
t_text: Akama, my friend!  Have you been informed?  I was found out by Vashj's followers.  Our secret is in peril!

w_text: Illidan is looking for me.  I am not safe here... none of us are.
t_text: Illidan is looking for me.  I am not safe here... none of us are.

w_text: Illidan will find me and when he does... he will pry the Ashtongue secret from me - such is the power of the Betrayer!  No... there is only one way.  My usefulness to the cause has come to an end. I must venture into the spirit world!
t_text: Illidan will find me and when he does... he will pry the Ashtongue secret from me - such is the power of the Betrayer!  No... there is only one way.  My usefulness to the cause has come to an end. I must venture into the spirit world!

w_text: My decision is final.  I will not be dissuaded.  I have devoted my life to our plan.  To jeopardize it now would betray all who have died for the cause long before me.
t_text: My decision is final.  I will not be dissuaded.  I have devoted my life to our plan.  To jeopardize it now would betray all who have died for the cause long before me.

w_text: I thank you, Akama.  You honor me by allowing me this moment, surrounded by my brothers.  Farewell, friend.  Guide our people well.
t_text: I thank you, Akama.  You honor me by allowing me this moment, surrounded by my brothers.  Farewell, friend.  Guide our people well.

w_text: There are few left in the world who can prepare the Ward of Waking, $n. We are fortunate that I am among them.
t_text: There are few left in the world who can prepare the Ward of Waking, $N. We are fortunate that I am among them.

t_text: The potion is finished. I can only hope Clintar forgives us for interrupting his sojourn in the Emerald Dream.

w_text: What are you doing in Ysera's realm, interloper? Leave us, I say! Your kind are not welcome here!
t_text: What are you doing in Ysera's realm, interloper? Leave us, I say! Your kind are not welcome here!

t_text: %s gets to his feet, beginning to recognize his surroundings.

w_text: You -- you're not one of them! Let's get out of sight before they find us! Hurry!
t_text: You -- you're not one of them! Let's get out of sight before they find us! Hurry!

w_text: They're following me, $r! Quickly, tell me why you're here before we're discovered! If they catch up to me, it will mean my death and yours!
t_text: They're following me, $r! Quickly, tell me why you're here before we're discovered! If they catch up to me, it will mean my death and yours!

w_text: %s becomes enraged!
t_text: %s becomes enraged!

w_text: Come closer, demon!  Death awaits!
t_text: Come closer, demon! Death awaits!

w_text: Illidan's lapdogs!  Destroy them all!
t_text: Illidan's lapdogs! Destroy them all!

w_text: I've a message for your master, scum!
t_text: I've a message for your master, scum!

w_text: Pathetic worm... your master's days are over!
t_text: Pathetic worm... your master's days are over!

w_text: For Xi'ri!  For the Sha'tar!
t_text: For Xi'ri!  For the Sha'tar!

w_text: Your end is at hand, Illidari!
t_text: Your end is at hand, Illidari!

w_text: Onward, Scryers!  Show Illidan's lackeys the temper of our steel!
t_text: Onward, Scryers! Show Illidan's lackeys the temper of our steel!

w_text: You disappoint me, Akama.  I wanted to question the treacherous worm myself!  I'm beginning to question your allegiance, Broken.
t_text: You disappoint me, Akama.  I wanted to question the treacherous worm myself!  I'm beginning to question your allegiance, Broken.

w_text: I do not sense lies in your voice, Akama.  That Kael'thas would betray me does not come as a big surprise - I'm not as oblivious as some would think. That one of your own was involved with him puts your loyalties into question.
t_text: I do not sense lies in your voice, Akama.  That Kael'thas would betray me does not come as a big surprise - I'm not as oblivious as some would think. That one of your own was involved with him puts your loyalties into question.

w_text: Send your Ashtongue into Tempest Keep and slay his most prized possession, the phoenix known as Al'ar.  I must know that you're not on his side.  Do not think of betraying me, Broken.  We both know who owns your soul!
t_text: Send your Ashtongue into Tempest Keep and slay his most prized possession, the phoenix known as Al'ar.  I must know that you're not on his side.  Do not think of betraying me, Broken.  We both know who owns your soul!

w_text: I was the first you know. For me the wheel of death has spun many times. So much time has passed... I have a lot of catching up to do.
t_text: I was the first you know. For me the wheel of death has spun many times. So much time has passed... I have a lot of catching up to do.

w_text: Vengeance is mine!
t_text: Vengeance is mine!

w_text: I have use for you...
t_text: I have use for you...

w_text: It gets worse.
t_text: It gets worse.

w_text: What are you afraid of?
t_text: What are you afraid of?

w_text: You will show the proper respect!
t_text: You will show the proper respect!

w_text: Death really isn't so bad.
t_text: Death really isn't so bad.

w_text: I have something for you...
t_text: I have something for you...

w_text: Give in.
t_text: Give in.

w_text: The wheel... spins... again.
t_text: The wheel... spins... again.

w_text: You will die in the name of Lady Vashj!
t_text: You will die in the name of Lady Vashj!

w_text: Stick around...
t_text: Stick around...

w_text: I'll deal with you later.
t_text: I'll deal with you later.

w_text: Your success was short-lived!
t_text: Your success was short-lived!

w_text: Time for you to go.
t_text: Time for you to go.

w_text: Be'lanen dalorai!
t_text: Be'lanen dalorai!

w_text: Blood... will... flow!
t_text: Blood... will... flow!

w_text: Bal, lamer zhita!
t_text: Bal, lamer zhita!

w_text: My patience has run out! Die! Die!
t_text: My patience has run out! Die! Die!

w_text: Lord Illidan will... crush you!
t_text: Lord Illidan will... crush you!

t_text: A %s erupts into the waking world from the Emerald Dream!

t_text: Supremus acquires a new target!

t_text: Supremus punches the ground in anger!

t_text: The ground begins to crack open!

w_text: Commander... I am not long for this world... Taken to a holding pen... hundreds... thousands... beings from other worlds... Imprisoned... Imprisoned by Ethereum. Many of them our allies. Must... Must save the others... It... It's not too late...
t_text: Commander... I am not long for this world... Taken to a holding pen... hundreds... thousands... beings from other worlds... Imprisoned... Imprisoned by Ethereum. Many of them our allies. Must... Must save the others... It... It's not too late...

t_text: A %s erupts into the waking world from the Emerald Dream!

t_text: Argh!  I will shred your soul and grind it to dust!

w_text: You dare summon me?

w_text: Now me grow bigger and crush you!
t_text: Now me grow bigger and crush you!

w_text: Lurosa, I am entrusting the Relics of Aviana to $n, who will take them to Morthis Whisperwing. I must return completely to the Emerald Dream now. Do not let $n fail!
t_text: Lurosa, I am entrusting the Relics of Aviana to $n, who will take them to Morthis Whisperwing. I must return completely to the Emerald Dream now. Do not let $n fail!

w_text: Come, my minions. Deal with this traitor as he deserves!
t_text: Come, my minions. Deal with this traitor as he deserves!

w_text: Who shall be next to taste my blades?
t_text: Who shall be next to taste my blades?

w_text: This is too easy!
t_text: This is too easy!

w_text: I will not be touched by rabble such as you!
t_text: I will not be touched by rabble such as you!

w_text: Behold the Flames of Azzinoth!
t_text: Behold the Flames of Azzinoth!

w_text: Stare into the eyes of the Betrayer!
t_text: Stare into the eyes of the Betrayer!

w_text: Behold the power... of the demon within!
t_text: Behold the power... of the demon within!

w_text: You've wasted too much time, mortals. Now you shall fall.
t_text: You've wasted too much time, mortals. Now you shall fall.

w_text: Feel the hatred of ten thousand years!
t_text: Feel the hatred of ten thousand years!

w_text: Give in to your fear!
t_text: Give in to your fear!

w_text: You know nothing of power!
t_text: You know nothing of power!

w_text: Such arrogance!
t_text: Such arrogance!

w_text: Akama. Your duplicity is hardly surprising. I should have slaughtered you and your malformed brethren long ago.
t_text: Akama. Your duplicity is hardly surprising. I should have slaughtered you and your malformed brethren long ago.

w_text: Boldly said. But I remain... unconvinced.
t_text: Boldly said. But I remain... unconvinced.

w_text: You are not prepared!
t_text: You are not prepared!

w_text: Is this it, mortals? Is this all the fury you can muster?
t_text: Is this it, mortals? Is this all the fury you can muster?

w_text: Maiev... How is it even possible?
t_text: Maiev... How is it even possible?

w_text: Feel the hatred of ten thousand years!
t_text: Feel the hatred of ten thousand years!

w_text: Now that that's out of the way, welcome to the Isle of Quel'Danas. The Sunwell's on the plateau to the south, and Prince Kael'thas is holed up in the Magisters' Terrace to the east.
t_text: Now that that's out of the way, welcome to the Isle of Quel'Danas. The Sunwell's on the plateau to the south, and Prince Kael'thas is holed up in the Magisters' Terrace to the east.

w_text: We're here as support for the so-called 'adventurers' that the brass has called in. We'll help them hold the key points on the island, and keep the heat off so that they can do their jobs.
t_text: We're here as support for the so-called 'adventurers' that the brass has called in. We'll help them hold the key points on the island, and keep the heat off so that they can do their jobs.

w_text: Welcome to the Sunwell. Despite the mild temperatures and scenic vistas, you're not on vacation, ladies and gentlemen!
t_text: Welcome to the Sunwell. Despite the mild temperatures and scenic vistas, you're not on vacation, ladies and gentlemen!

w_text: The current situation looks like this: we're holding what we can while those with more experience and better equipment are moving against Prince Kael'thas.
t_text: The current situation looks like this: we're holding what we can while those with more experience and better equipment are moving against Prince Kael'thas.

w_text: I know, we thought he was dead too, but that's not the case. He's trying to use the Sunwell to bring the master of the Burning Legion, Kil'Jaeden, into this world.
t_text: I know, we thought he was dead too, but that's not the case. He's trying to use the Sunwell to bring the master of the Burning Legion, Kil'Jaeden, into this world.

w_text: Let me assure you people that if he's successful, this world will suffer far worse than Outland ever did! So, let's make sure that doesn't come to pass.
t_text: Let me assure you people that if he's successful, this world will suffer far worse than Outland ever did! So, let's make sure that doesn't come to pass.

w_text: Hello to you new recruits. I'm Drill Sergeant Bahduum. For the next few days, you're going to receive orientation.

w_text: The Isle of Quel'Danas has been overrun by the forces of Prince Kael'thas Sunstrider. Intel had him pegged as deceased. Intel was wrong.
t_text: The Isle of Quel'Danas has been overrun by the forces of Prince Kael'thas Sunstrider. Intel had him pegged as deceased. Intel was wrong.

w_text: Up on the plateau, he and his demon friends are trying to reignite the Sunwell and open a rift to bring their head-honcho, Kil'Jaeden, back into the world.
t_text: Up on the plateau, he and his demon friends are trying to reignite the Sunwell and open a rift to bring their head-honcho, Kil'Jaeden, back into the world.

w_text: Our job is to clear out as much of his fodder as we can, while supporting the specialists that the powers-that-be are having brought in.
t_text: Our job is to clear out as much of his fodder as we can, while supporting the specialists that the powers-that-be are having brought in.

w_text: Needless to say, a lot of us won't be going home. But if you remember your training and keep your wits about you, you'll greatly increase your chances.
t_text: Needless to say, a lot of us won't be going home. But if you remember your training and keep your wits about you, you'll greatly increase your chances.

w_text: That's all I have to say for now. Stay focused, boys and girls.

w_text: Our minds were finally free, yes... Free to relive all of the unthinkable acts that we had performed under the Legions' influence.
t_text: Our minds were finally free, yes... Free to relive all of the unthinkable acts that we had performed under the Legions' influence.

t_text: %s raises his talons menacingly!

w_text: By royal edict, you men are to return to Lordaeron immediately. Lord Uther has convinced the king to recall this expedition.
t_text: By royal edict, you men are to return to Lordaeron immediately. Lord Uther has convinced the king to recall this expedition.

w_text: That's correct. My men report that the roads from here to the shore are held by the undead. You'll need to find an alternate route back to your ships.
t_text: That's correct. My men report that the roads from here to the shore are held by the undead. You'll need to find an alternate route back to your ships.

w_text: %s goes into a frenzy!
t_text: %s goes into a frenzy!

w_text: We're all gonna die!
t_text: We're all gonna die!

w_text: Gotta get out of here!
t_text: Gotta get out of here!

w_text: No way I'm stickin' around!
t_text: No way I'm stickin' around!

w_text: Forget this! I'm going home!
t_text: Forget this! I'm going home!

w_text: I didn't sign up for this!
t_text: I didn't sign up for this!

w_text: %s growls.
t_text: %s growls.

w_text: %s hisses!
t_text: %s hisses!

w_text: Tell you nothing, preacher.
t_text: Tell you nothing, preacher.

w_text: What can you do to me that Kel'Thuzad has not? That the Lich King will not?
t_text: What can you do to me that Kel'Thuzad has not? That the Lich King will not?

w_text: The book is your salvation, yes... but nothing will you know! NOTHING I SAY! NOTHING!
t_text: The book is your salvation, yes... but nothing will you know! NOTHING I SAY! NOTHING!

w_text: No more LIGHT! NO MORE! I BEG YOU!
t_text: No more LIGHT! NO MORE! I BEG YOU!

w_text: Never felt hurt like this!
t_text: Never felt hurt like this!

w_text: It tells of the coming apocalypse. How this world will burn and be reborn from death.
t_text: It tells of the coming apocalypse. How this world will burn and be reborn from death.

w_text: NOOOO!!! I tell you! I tell you everything!
t_text: NOOOO!!! I tell you! I tell you everything!

w_text: Humans... Beneath the earth of Wintergarde Village you built a mausoleum! Why do you think Naxxramas attacked that spot? Thel'zan hides deep in your own crypt and sends a thousand-thousand corpses at you! Perish you will...
t_text: Humans... Beneath the earth of Wintergarde Village you built a mausoleum! Why do you think Naxxramas attacked that spot? Thel'zan hides deep in your own crypt and sends a thousand-thousand corpses at you! Perish you will...

w_text: How? Humans truly are stupid, yes? Thel'zan the Duskbringer! Thel'zan the Lich! He who is born of human flesh and bone, sacrificed all for power, protected by the Lich King!
t_text: How? Humans truly are stupid, yes? Thel'zan the Duskbringer! Thel'zan the Lich! He who is born of human flesh and bone, sacrificed all for power, protected by the Lich King!

w_text: You cannot stop Thel'zan! He bears the dark gift, bestowed upon him by the Lich King himself!
t_text: You cannot stop Thel'zan! He bears the dark gift, bestowed upon him by the Lich King himself!

w_text: Without you we'd be lost. Thanks for the ride!
t_text: Without you we'd be lost. Thanks for the ride!

w_text: For the Alliance and Lord Fordragon!
t_text: For the Alliance and Lord Fordragon!

w_text: HOO-WAH! The cavalry has arrived!
t_text: HOO-WAH! The cavalry has arrived!

w_text: Great driving, soldier! Not a scratch on us!
t_text: Great driving, soldier! Not a scratch on us!

w_text: I think I see one of their plague wagons!
t_text: I think I see one of their plague wagons!

w_text: Did I ever tell you soldiers about the time I destroyed the Thandol Span? Yep, weren't no dark irons destroyed that bridge! Was me!
t_text: Did I ever tell you soldiers about the time I destroyed the Thandol Span? Yep, weren't no dark irons destroyed that bridge! Was me!

w_text: It doesn't make any sense. Why don't they just fly Naxxramas over Wintergarde Keep and blow it up? I mean, that's what I would do if I were Kel'Thuzad.
t_text: It doesn't make any sense. Why don't they just fly Naxxramas over Wintergarde Keep and blow it up? I mean, that's what I would do if I were Kel'Thuzad.

w_text: I wonder if we'll ever solve the mystery of the strange ore. There's gotta be some use for it!
t_text: I wonder if we'll ever solve the mystery of the strange ore. There's gotta be some use for it!

w_text: Hey, do any of you know McGoyver over at Valgarde? He's my uncle. You know what his title is? Pro. Yea, just "Pro." I want to be a pro too.
t_text: Hey, do any of you know McGoyver over at Valgarde? He's my uncle. You know what his title is? Pro. Yea, just "Pro." I want to be a pro too.

w_text: Something straight up stinks in here! It's definitely not me. Gnomes smell like butter and sunshine. Not like those dwarves that smell like they were born from a trogg's armpit! None of you are dwarves, are you?
t_text: Something straight up stinks in here! It's definitely not me. Gnomes smell like butter and sunshine. Not like those dwarves that smell like they were born from a trogg's armpit! None of you are dwarves, are you?

w_text: I used to know a dwarf that claimed gnomes evolved from beneath the earth. That we all started out as sand gnomes. What a load of nonsense! Sand gnomes? PUH-LEASE!
t_text: I used to know a dwarf that claimed gnomes evolved from beneath the earth. That we all started out as sand gnomes. What a load of nonsense! Sand gnomes? PUH-LEASE!

w_text: I've never seen destruction like this...
t_text: I've never seen destruction like this...

w_text: Keep the chatter down, people. We need to stay alert!
t_text: Keep the chatter down, people. We need to stay alert!

w_text: The smell of death covers every inch of this place.
t_text: The smell of death covers every inch of this place.

w_text: Driver, I hear you single handedly airlifted our villagers out of this hell-hole. Is that true?
t_text: Driver, I hear you single handedly airlifted our villagers out of this hell-hole. Is that true?

w_text: So does anyone know anything about Thel'zan? Who is he? How did he come to leading the Scourge armies on the ground?
t_text: So does anyone know anything about Thel'zan? Who is he? How did he come to leading the Scourge armies on the ground?

w_text: Look at this mess... The Scourge will pay for this!
t_text: Look at this mess... The Scourge will pay for this!

w_text: Where are all the corpses? What have they done to our people?
t_text: Where are all the corpses? What have they done to our people?

w_text: I hope I'm alive to see Arthas get what's coming to him.
t_text: I hope I'm alive to see Arthas get what's coming to him.

w_text: Reporting for duty, sir!
t_text: Reporting for duty, sir!

w_text: Rise, Arugal!  The power of the Lich King commands you!
t_text: Rise, Arugal!  The power of the Lich King commands you!

w_text: Yes... he shall suit our needs perfectly.  Have him sent to Solstice Village when you're ready.  Arthas will not be pleased if we fall behind schedule.
t_text: Yes... he shall suit our needs perfectly.  Have him sent to Solstice Village when you're ready.  Arthas will not be pleased if we fall behind schedule.

w_text: Are you ready for battle, $c?
t_text: Are you ready for battle, $c?

w_text: Take us into battle, $n!
t_text: Take us into battle, $n!

w_text: Shall we destabilize the shrine first or disable the enemy?
t_text: Shall we destabilize the shrine first or disable the enemy?

w_text: We've been expecting you, $n. Now we have the upper hand.
t_text: We've been expecting you, $n. Now we have the upper hand.

w_text: I can't believe the blues would attack us. Let's give some of it back!
t_text: I can't believe the blues would attack us. Let's give some of it back!

w_text: I am ready. Let's defend the temple!
t_text: I am ready. Let's defend the temple!

w_text: Where to first?
t_text: Where to first?

w_text: Your reputation precedes you, $n. This should be interesting.
t_text: Your reputation precedes you, $n. This should be interesting.

w_text: I never thought that I'd be riding into battle with a $r on my back.
t_text: I never thought that I'd be riding into battle with a $r on my back.

w_text: Another blue down. We make a great team!
t_text: Another blue down. We make a great team!

w_text: With you and I working together, this battle will be over in no time.
t_text: With you and I working together, this battle will be over in no time.

w_text: Malygos has clearly gone insane.
t_text: Malygos has clearly gone insane.

w_text: Nice one, kid.
t_text: Nice one, kid.

w_text: I've never seen anything like this before. I'm glad that you're here.
t_text: I've never seen anything like this before. I'm glad that you're here.

w_text: I'm glad you saw that one!
t_text: I'm glad you saw that one!

w_text: Just hang on. We'll get through this.
t_text: Just hang on. We'll get through this.

w_text: We should get out of here. I need to renew!
t_text: We should get out of here. I need to renew!

w_text: %s becomes enraged!
t_text: %s becomes enraged!

w_text: You won't eat me, will you?
t_text: You won't eat me, will you?

w_text: Sister!  The mean men were going to take me to Badmoon Isle.  They wanted to turn me into one of them.
t_text: Sister!  The mean men were going to take me to Badmoon Isle.  They wanted to turn me into one of them.

w_text: That's what I said!  Badmoon!  Sasha... don't ever leave me again!  First they took papa, then they took you... I don't want to be alone with them!
t_text: That's what I said!  Badmoon!  Sasha... don't ever leave me again!  First they took papa, then they took you... I don't want to be alone with them!

w_text: The prisoners shall not go free! The word of Malygos is law!
t_text: The prisoners shall not go free! The word of Malygos is law!

w_text: A fitting punishment.
t_text: A fitting punishment.

w_text: Sentence executed!
t_text: Sentence executed!

w_text: Another casualty of war!
t_text: Another casualty of war!

w_text: The war... goes on.
t_text: The war... goes on.

w_text: It is too late to run!
t_text: It is too late to run!

w_text: Gather 'round....
t_text: Gather 'round....

w_text: None shall escape!
t_text: None shall escape!

w_text: I condemn you to death!
t_text: I condemn you to death!

w_text: Tremble, worms!
t_text: Tremble, worms!

w_text: I will crush you!
t_text: I will crush you!

w_text: Can you fly?
t_text: Can you fly?

w_text: %s begins to cast Magic Pull!
t_text: %s begins to cast Magic Pull!

w_text: What do we have here... those that would defy the Spell-Weaver? Those without foresight or understanding. How can I make you see? Malygos is saving the world from itself! Bah! You are hardly worth my time!
t_text: What do we have here... those that would defy the Spell-Weaver? Those without foresight or understanding. How can I make you see? Malygos is saving the world from itself! Bah! You are hardly worth my time!

w_text: Clearly my pets failed. Perhaps another demonstration is in order.
t_text: Clearly my pets failed. Perhaps another demonstration is in order.

w_text: Still you fight. Still you cling to misguided principles. If you survive, you'll find me in the center ring.
t_text: Still you fight. Still you cling to misguided principles. If you survive, you'll find me in the center ring.

w_text: Poor blind fools!
t_text: Poor blind fools!

w_text: %s begins to cast Empowered Arcane Explosion!
t_text: %s begins to cast Empowered Arcane Explosion!

w_text: A taste... just a small taste... of the Spell-Weaver's power!
t_text: A taste... just a small taste... of the Spell-Weaver's power!

w_text: So much unstable energy... but worth the risk to destroy you!
t_text: So much unstable energy... but worth the risk to destroy you!

w_text: Everything I have done... has been for Azeroth....
t_text: Everything I have done... has been for Azeroth....

w_text: If only you understood!
t_text: If only you understood!

w_text: Now do you see? Do you?!
t_text: Now do you see? Do you?!

w_text: Unfortunate, but necessary.
t_text: Unfortunate, but necessary.

w_text: Simpletons! You cannot comprehend the forces you have set in motion. The ley line conduit will not be disrupted! Your defeat shall be absolute!
t_text: Simpletons! You cannot comprehend the forces you have set in motion. The ley line conduit will not be disrupted! Your defeat shall be absolute!

w_text: You brash interlopers are out of your element! I will ground you!
t_text: You brash interlopers are out of your element! I will ground you!

w_text: Such insolence... such arrogance... must be PUNISHED!
t_text: Such insolence... such arrogance... must be PUNISHED!

w_text: It's a long way down....
t_text: It's a long way down....

w_text: Back to the earth with you!
t_text: BACK to the earth with you!

w_text: Enjoy the fall!
t_text: Enjoy the fall!

w_text: Savor this small victory, foolish little creatures. You and your dragon allies have won this battle, but we will win... the Nexus War.
t_text: Savor this small victory, foolish little creatures. You and your dragon allies have won this battle, but we will win... the Nexus War.

w_text: We command the arcane! It shall not be used against us!
t_text: We command the arcane! It shall not be used against us!

w_text: It is trivial to extinguish your fire!
t_text: It is trivial to extinguish your fire!

w_text: No magic of nature will help you now!
t_text: No magic of nature will help you now!

w_text: Thank you for freeing us, mortals.  Beware, the blue flight is alerted to your presence.  Even now, Malygos sends Varos Cloudstrider and his ring guardians to defend the Oculus.  You will need our help to stand a chance.
t_text: Thank you for freeing us, mortals.  Beware, the blue flight is alerted to your presence.  Even now, Malygos sends Varos Cloudstrider and his ring guardians to defend the Oculus.  You will need our help to stand a chance.

w_text: I've lived here and kept this shrine with the blessing of the Alexstrasza for longer than I can remember.  In its darkest hour, I've failed... I fell at the feet of that damned death knight...  Bloodbane.
t_text: I've lived here and kept this shrine with the blessing of the Alexstrasza for longer than I can remember.  In its darkest hour, I've failed... I fell at the feet of that damned death knight...  Bloodbane.

w_text: Dahlia spits on the ground at the thought of the name.
t_text: Dahlia spits on the ground at the thought of the name.

w_text: The Lich King is stretching his hand far now... fearlessly treading on the most sacred lands of all of the flights.  He intends to force us to action.
t_text: The Lich King is stretching his hand far now... fearlessly treading on the most sacred lands of all of the flights.  He intends to force us to action.

w_text: My time is done... I offered myself to Alexstrasza in life, but I have nothing left to offer in death.  She will need a new keeper for her shrine.
t_text: My time is done... I offered myself to Alexstrasza in life, but I have nothing left to offer in death.  She will need a new keeper for her shrine.

w_text: And thank you... thank you for freeing me from the shackles of the damned.  You are a hero... I know you will go on to great deeds.
t_text: And thank you... thank you for freeing me from the shackles of the damned.  You are a hero... I know you will go on to great deeds.

w_text: The Remnant of Dahlia Suntouch fades away...
t_text: The Remnant of Dahlia Suntouch fades away...

w_text: %s flies away.
t_text: %s flies away.

w_text: Welcome Friend.  Keep your head down and hold on tight!
t_text: Welcome Friend.  Keep your head down and hold on tight!

w_text: Use Leeching Poison to damage enemies and keep me healed.  Touch the Nightmare is very powerful, but it hurts me, so only use it when I have a lot of health!
t_text: Use Leeching Poison to damage enemies and keep me healed.  Touch the Nightmare is very powerful, but it hurts me, so only use it when I have a lot of health!

w_text: Now that I am at my full power I can perform Dream Funnel.  You can use it to heal other drakes, but it drains my health, so make sure you're using Leeching Poison too!
t_text: Now that I am at my full power I can perform Dream Funnel.  You can use it to heal other drakes, but it drains my health, so make sure you're using Leeching Poison too!

w_text: I'm badly injured!  I can't take much more of this!
t_text: I'm badly injured!  I can't take much more of this!

t_text: Mage-Lord Urom is our next target.  He should be hiding on one of the floating platforms on the Band of Transmutation, near the top of The Oculus.  Be warned, Urom is a powerful conjurer; he may not be alone.
