t_text: Ley-Guardian Eregos is all that now stands between us and control of The Oculus.  He's flying above the Band of Alignment, at the very top of The Oculus.  Eregos is incredibly powerful; stay on my back when we engage him and leave the fighting to me.

w_text: We've wrested control of The Oculus from the forces of Malygos.  You're not getting any lighter, little one.  My wings itch for the open sky.
t_text: We've wrested control of The Oculus from the forces of Malygos.  You're not getting any lighter, little one.  My wings itch for the open sky.

w_text: What is it?
t_text: What is it?

w_text: Is this the end? If we stop this monster now, is victory assured at the Wrathgate?
t_text: Is this the end? If we stop this bastard now, is victory assured at the Wrathgate?

w_text: Let it be known that it has been an honor and a privilege fighting alongside all of you.
t_text: Let it be known that it has been an honor and a privilege fighting alongside all of you.

w_text: Death comes for us all eventually, but sometimes it comes a little faster than anticipated. Today we call that blind heroics... Tomorrow someone may call it stupidity.
t_text: Death comes for us all eventually, but sometimes it comes a little faster than anticipated. Today we call that blind heroics... Tomorrow someone may call it stupidity.

w_text: Come on... Let's get this over with!
t_text: Come on... Let's get this over with!

w_text: It looks like a gateway to hell!
t_text: It looks like a gateway to hell!

w_text: I'm getting a little worried. Where is this hero that is supposed to lead us into battle?
t_text: I'm getting a little worried. Where is this hero that is supposed to lead us into battle?

w_text: If I don't make it back to Wintergarde, let my family know that I did my best and that I love them...
t_text: If I don't make it back to Wintergarde, let my family know that I did my best and that I love them...

w_text: It's the Highlord!
t_text: It's the Highlord!

w_text: Ladies and gentlemen!  Well... let's just say you don't want to miss this one!
t_text: Ladies and gentlemen!  Well... let's just say you don't want to miss this one!

w_text: I used good judgment when you showed none.  I don't want to see you lead us into ruin, Krenna!
t_text: I used good judgment when you showed none.  I don't want to see you lead us into ruin, Krenna!

w_text: It doesn't have to end this way, you know?
t_text: It doesn't have to end this way, you know?

w_text: We'll see about that.
t_text: We'll see about that.

w_text: Why... why sister?  Why did it have to come to this?
t_text: Why... why sister?  Why did it have to come to this?

w_text: You went behind my back.  You neglected my orders.  You will pay the price.
t_text: You went behind my back.  You neglected my orders.  You will pay the price.

w_text: Enough talk.  By the time I'm through with you, not even the worgs are going to want to go near your corpse.
t_text: Enough talk.  By the time I'm through with you, not even the worgs are going to want to go near your corpse.

w_text: Use Shock Lance to damage enemies.  If we get in trouble, Stop Time to freeze all enemies in place, then hit them with Shock Lance for massive damage!
t_text: Use Shock Lance to damage enemies.  If we get in trouble, Stop Time to freeze all enemies in place, then hit them with Shock Lance for massive damage!

w_text: Mage-Lord Urom is our next target.  He should be hiding on one of the floating platforms on the Band of Transmutation, near the top of The Oculus.  Be warned, Urom is a powerful conjurer; he may not be alone.
t_text: Mage-Lord Urom is our next target.  He should be hiding on one of the floating platforms on the Band of Transmutation, near the top of The Oculus.  Be warned, Urom is a powerful conjurer; he may not be alone.

w_text: Ley-Guardian Eregos is all that now stands between us and control of The Oculus.  He's flying above the Band of Alignment, at the very top of The Oculus.  Eregos is incredibly powerful; stay on my back when we engage him and leave the fighting to me.
t_text: Ley-Guardian Eregos is all that now stands between us and control of The Oculus.  He's flying above the Band of Alignment, at the very top of The Oculus.  Eregos is incredibly powerful; stay on my back when we engage him and leave the fighting to me.

w_text: We've wrested control of The Oculus from the forces of Malygos.  You're not getting any lighter, little one.  My wings itch for the open sky.
t_text: We've wrested control of The Oculus from the forces of Malygos.  You're not getting any lighter, little one.  My wings itch for the open sky.

w_text: Next, I shall speak of the most powerful entities within the pinnacle of Naxxramas. Truly, these are two of the greatest threats to all of Northrend.
t_text: Next, I shall speak of the most powerful entities within the pinnacle of Naxxramas. Truly, these are two of the greatest threats to all of Northrend.

w_text: Next, I shall speak of the death knight wing of Naxxramas. Within its corrupted halls, the echo of battle rings day and night, as our finest warriors are corrupted and twisted into the Scourge's greatest warriors.
t_text: Next, I shall speak of the death knight wing of Naxxramas. Within its corrupted halls, the echo of battle rings day and night, as our finest warriors are corrupted and twisted into the Scourge's greatest warriors.

w_text: Next, I shall speak of the blighted abomination wing of Naxxramas. There, the Scourge develop the strongest and most hideous aberrations of their armies.
t_text: Next, I shall speak of the blighted abomination wing of Naxxramas. There, the Scourge develop the strongest and most hideous aberrations of their armies.

w_text: Next, I shall speak of the accursed spider wing of Naxxramas. It is there the Scourge breed even more poisonous and dangerous versions of their kin.
t_text: Next, I shall speak of the accursed spider wing of Naxxramas. It is there the Scourge breed even more poisonous and dangerous versions of their kin.

w_text: Next, I shall speak of the dread plague wing of Naxxramas, where the Scourge seek to improve upon the deadly blight which they spread across Lordaeron.
t_text: Next, I shall speak of the dread plague wing of Naxxramas, where the Scourge seek to improve upon the deadly blight which they spread across Lordaeron.

w_text: I shall leave this image on display for your perusal. Study your opponents' strengths, for a creature's strength can also be its weakness.
t_text: I shall leave this image on display for your perusal. Study your opponents' strengths, for a creature's strength can also be its weakness.

w_text: Sapphiron. Once a noble blue dragon within the mountains of Northrend, Sapphiron was slain by Arthas during his campaign through the frozen north. Resurrected to serve him, Sapphiron guards Kel'thuzad's lair eternally, awaiting those who would dare tresspass upon his master.
t_text: Sapphiron. Once a noble blue dragon within the mountains of Northrend, Sapphiron was slain by Arthas during his campaign through the frozen north. Resurrected to serve him, Sapphiron guards Kel'thuzad's lair eternally, awaiting those who would dare tresspass upon his master.

w_text: The lich, Kel'Thuzad. He serves the Lich King without question, a necromancer of great prowess in life, turned into a master of necromancy after his death. It is said he is the most loyal of the Lich King's subjects.
t_text: The lich, Kel'Thuzad. He serves the Lich King without question, a necromancer of great prowess in life, turned into a master of necromancy after his death. It is said he is the most loyal of the Lich King's subjects.

w_text: Kel'thuzad has survived trials that would have long since shattered the souls of even the greatest of the Brotherhood. He readily gave his life at Arthas's hand, later to be brought back - reborn in the power of the Sunwell.
t_text: Kel'thuzad has survived trials that would have long since shattered the souls of even the greatest of the Brotherhood. He readily gave his life at Arthas's hand, later to be brought back - reborn in the power of the Sunwell.

w_text: In the Plaguelands, Kel'thuzad was again defeated by the agents of the Argent Dawn. However, his phylactery was delivered to a false agent of the Brotherhood. We have yet to discover who stole his phylactery or why.
t_text: In the Plaguelands, Kel'thuzad was again defeated by the agents of the Argent Dawn. However, his phylactery was delivered to a false agent of the Brotherhood. We have yet to discover who stole his phylactery or why.

w_text: Pay attention. This is Instructor Razuvious, Kel'Thuzad's appointed trainer of all death knights. It is said that his own technique is so potent, only a disciple of his could possibly withstand his might.
t_text: Pay attention. This is Instructor Razuvious, Kel'Thuzad's appointed trainer of all death knights. It is said that his own technique is so potent, only a disciple of his could possibly withstand his might.

w_text: Gothik, the Harvester. A master of necromancy and conjuration, Gothik is said to be able to beckon forth legions of the undead at a moment's notice. It is with his guidance that even the weakest of Death Knights can raise the dead.
t_text: Gothik, the Harvester. A master of necromancy and conjuration, Gothik is said to be able to beckon forth legions of the undead at a moment's notice. It is with his guidance that even the weakest of Death Knights can raise the dead.

w_text: The most powerful death knights within Naxxramas are the four horsemen. They represent the pinnacle of Kel'Thuzad's guard. The first, Thane Korth'azz, holds the power of flame.
t_text: The most powerful death knights within Naxxramas are the four horsemen. They represent the pinnacle of Kel'Thuzad's guard. The first, Thane Korth'azz, holds the power of flame.

w_text: The next, Lady Blaumeux, calls forth the power of shadows, drawing the souls of the living into the voracious embrace.
t_text: The next, Lady Blaumeux, calls forth the power of shadows, drawing the souls of the living into the voracious embrace.

w_text: Sir Zeliek, a paladin in life, so strong in his faith, that even in undeath, the power of the light still heeds his call, smiting his foes in battle.
t_text: Sir Zeliek, a paladin in life, so strong in his faith, that even in undeath, the power of the light still heeds his call, smiting his foes in battle.

w_text: The final death knight, Lord Mograine, was the finest warrior that the death knights had ever seen. However, after the events in Azeroth, he vanished without a trace. It is yet to be seen who Kel'Thuzad has appointed in his place.
t_text: The final death knight, Lord Mograine, was the finest warrior that the death knights had ever seen. However, after the events in Azeroth, he vanished without a trace. It is yet to be seen who Kel'Thuzad has appointed in his place.

w_text: Behold, Patchwerk. When word of his existence first reached the ears of the Brotherhood, none believed the tales of an abomination with such immense speed and strength. Fewer still believed it when he fell the first time...
t_text: Behold, Patchwerk. When word of his existence first reached the ears of the Brotherhood, none believed the tales of an abomination with such immense speed and strength. Fewer still believed it when he fell the first time...

w_text: Grobbulus, the first of what was to be an army of flesh giants. It carried the plague slime of Naxxramas within its body, injecting the living ooze into the bodies of its foe. The recipient of this foul injection would usually flee to his allies, bringing them down with him.
t_text: Grobbulus, the first of what was to be an army of flesh giants. It carried the plague slime of Naxxramas within its body, injecting the living ooze into the bodies of its foe. The recipient of this foul injection would usually flee to his allies, bringing them down with him.

w_text: Gluth, the foul plague-dog of Naxxramas, was said to have an appetite so voracious that even the living were not enough to satisfy his hunger. Feugen was said to feed him an army of zombies daily, recycling the remains of undead too weak to use in combat.
t_text: Gluth, the foul plague-dog of Naxxramas, was said to have an appetite so voracious that even the living were not enough to satisfy his hunger. Feugen was said to feed him an army of zombies daily, recycling the remains of undead too weak to use in combat.

w_text: Thaddius, built from the flesh of women and children, it is said that their souls are fused together - eternally bound within that foul prison of flesh.
t_text: Thaddius, built from the flesh of women and children, it is said that their souls are fused together - eternally bound within that foul prison of flesh.

w_text: Anub'Rekhan, one of the finest Spider Lords of Azjol'Nerub, was brought under the control of the Scourge when he and his former commander, Anub'arak, were finally defeated by Lich King many years ago. It is said that he was the most loyal of Anub'arak's commanders.
t_text: Anub'Rekhan, one of the finest Spider Lords of Azjol'Nerub, was brought under the control of the Scourge when he and his former commander, Anub'arak, were finally defeated by Lich King many years ago. It is said that he was the most loyal of Anub'arak's commanders.

w_text: The Grand Widow Faerlina, a botanist in life, breeder and caretaker of arachnids in death, she overseers the spider wing, developing the most potent of poisons for the Lich King.
t_text: The Grand Widow Faerlina, a botanist in life, breeder and caretaker of arachnids in death, she overseers the spider wing, developing the most potent of poisons for the Lich King.

w_text: Maexxna, born deep within the mountains of Northrend many ages ago, she was captured within the dread citadel Naxxramas, where she gives birth to her brood, feeding them the corpses of all who dare venture too deeply into Naxxramas.
t_text: Maexxna, born deep within the mountains of Northrend many ages ago, she was captured within the dread citadel Naxxramas, where she gives birth to her brood, feeding them the corpses of all who dare venture too deeply into Naxxramas.

w_text: Behold, Noth the Plaguebringer. Responsible for the creation of the process that distills the souls of the living and places them within the cold cage of undeath, Noth was observed to be refining this process even now.
t_text: Behold, Noth the Plaguebringer. Responsible for the creation of the process that distills the souls of the living and places them within the cold cage of undeath, Noth was observed to be refining this process even now.

w_text: Observe, Heigan the Unclean. The mastermind behind the plague cauldrons that turned the wilderness of Azeroth into the Plaguelands.
t_text: Observe, Heigan the Unclean. The mastermind behind the plague cauldrons that turned the wilderness of Azeroth into the Plaguelands.

w_text: It is said that Heigan has rigged the very walls and floors of Naxxramas itself with a vast array of traps, which he can trigger at will.
t_text: It is said that Heigan has rigged the very walls and floors of Naxxramas itself with a vast array of traps, which he can trigger at will.

w_text: Loatheb. The hideous result of fusing the living plague of the Plaguelands with the bog beasts of Azeroth, Loatheb is said to control the power of healing itself.
t_text: Loatheb. The hideous result of fusing the living plague of the Plaguelands with the bog beasts of Azeroth, Loatheb is said to control the power of healing itself.

w_text: I was almost ghoul bait! Thanks for the rescue!
t_text: I was almost ghoul bait! Thanks for the rescue!

w_text: It's a good thing you came along, ally! We were done for!
t_text: It's a good thing you came along, ally! We were done for!

w_text: Thanks for the cover fire! It's a MADHOUSE down there!
t_text: Thanks for the cover fire! It's a MADHOUSE down there!

w_text: Wow, I thought I was a goner! Thanks, friend!
t_text: Wow, I thought I was a goner! Thanks, friend!

w_text: Bat gizzards again for the gnomes tonight...
t_text: Bat gizzards again for the gnomes tonight...

w_text: What do they expect, making the bats come in at that angle? Broken necks and gamey bat stew, that's what they get.
t_text: What do they expect, making the bats come in at that angle? Broken necks and gamey bat stew, that's what they get.

w_text: 'We like the trees, Fenrick. They provide cover.' They won't let me chop them down, either.
t_text: 'We like the trees, Fenrick. They provide cover.' They won't let me chop them down, either.

w_text: I wonder how many reinforcements need to suffer injury before they allow us to chop down these idiotic trees. They're costing us a fortune in bats. Maybe I'll rig a harness or two...
t_text: I wonder how many reinforcements need to suffer injury before they allow us to chop down these idiotic trees. They're costing us a fortune in bats. Maybe I'll rig a harness or two...

w_text: Guards help!
t_text: Guards help!

w_text: I'll flush her out, $n! You just be ready for her when she comes in!
t_text: I'll flush her out, $N! You just be ready for her when she comes in!

w_text: FIRE! FIRE! BRING HER DOWN!
t_text: FIRE! FIRE! BRING HER DOWN!

w_text: The walls of Frostmourne Cavern shudder and shake.
t_text: The walls of Frostmourne Cavern shudder and shake.

w_text: Steel yourselves, soldiers. $n has provided us with the final piece of this puzzle. The dread lich, Thel'zan, will soon come out of hiding, only to be rendered powerless against us!
t_text: Steel yourselves, soldiers. $N has provided us us with the final piece of this puzzle. The dread lich, Thel'zan, will soon come out of hiding, only to be rendered powerless against us!

w_text: It is this phylactery - Thel'zan's phylactery - that is the key to victory!
t_text: It is this phylactery, Thel'zan's phylactery - that is the key to this victory!

w_text: LEGION, STEADY YOURSELVES!
t_text: LEGION, STEADY YOURSELVES!

w_text: Honor, courage, compassion and justice! These were once the virtues you fought for as a cleric of the Argent Dawn, Thel'zan.
t_text: Honor, courage, compassion and justice! Those were once the virtues you fought for as a cleric of the Argent Dawn, Thel'zan.

w_text: You dedicated your whole life to fighting the Scourge. You saw what they did to our beloved Lordaeron. The Lich King took everything from you!
t_text: You dedicated your whole life to fighting the Scourge. You saw what they did to our beloved Lordaeron. The Lich King took everything from you!

w_text: So how, then, did Father Inigo Montoy, bastion of virtue for the Argent Dawn, become the embodiment of that which he hated most?
t_text: So how, then, did Father Inigo Montoy, bastion of virtue for the Argent Dawn, become the embodiment of that which he hated most?

w_text: Now, be free and join the battle! Let us end this together!
t_text: Now, be free and join the battle! Let us end this together!

w_text: Victory for the Alliance!
t_text: Victory for the Alliance!

w_text: You have saved Wintergarde! With Thel'zan's filth washed away, the 7th Legion will easily clean up the remaining Scourge. When you are done here, report to Angrathar!
t_text: You have saved Wintergarde! With Thel'zan's filth washed away, the 7th Legion will easily clean up the remaining Scourge. When you are done here, report to Angrathar!

w_text: %s goes into a frenzy!
t_text: %s goes into a frenzy!

w_text: No, Sergeant.
t_text: No, Sergeant.

w_text: No, sir.
t_text: No, sir.

w_text: Nope.
t_text: Nope.

w_text: Yes, sir.
t_text: Yes, sir.

w_text: Yes, Sergeant Morigan.
t_text: Yes, Sergeant Morigan.

w_text: Absolutely.
t_text: Absolutely.

w_text: What are you talking about, Sergeant!
t_text: What are you talking about, Sergeant!

w_text: You have to believe me, I'm innocent!
t_text: You have to believe me, I'm innocent!

w_text: Mr. Perelli, have you seen any suspicious activity by men wearing dark robes in the last few weeks?
t_text: Mr. Perelli, have you seen any suspicious activity by men wearing dark robes in the last few weeks?

w_text: Mr. Perelli, have you seen any signs of the undead? Any information you can provide would be appreciated by Prince Arthas.
t_text: Mr. Perelli, have you seen any signs of the undead? Any information you can provide would be appreciated by Prince Arthas.

w_text: Mr. Perelli, I know you travel around quite a bit hawking your goods. Surely you've heard rumors or information about the Scourge?
t_text: Mr. Perelli, I know you travel around quite a bit hawking your goods. Surely you've heard rumors or information about the Scourge?

w_text: Do you plan on leaving the area soon if we have further questions?
t_text: Do you plan on leaving the area soon if we have further questions?

w_text: Mr. Perelli, have these goods been under your supervision at all times?
t_text: Mr. Perelli, have these goods been under your supervision at all times?

w_text: You wouldn't happen to have any canned turtle soup from Hillsbrad, would you?
t_text: You wouldn't happen to have any canned turtle soup from Hillsbrad, would you?

w_text: Mr. Perelli, if you happen across any signs of Scourge activity or shady dealings in your travels, let the nearest Lordaeron soldier know.
t_text: Mr. Perelli, if you happen across any signs of Scourge activity or shady dealings in your travels, let the nearest Lordaeron soldier know.

w_text: You don't mind me checking out your merchandise for signs of tampering, do you?
t_text: You don't mind me checking out your merchandise for signs of tampering, do you?

w_text: Wait, what is this? You've been holding out on me, Perelli!
t_text: Wait, what is this? You've been holding out on me, Perelli!

w_text: I'm confiscating this suspicious grain, Perelli. We were looking for signs of tampered food, and it would be in your best interest to stay put while Prince Arthas checks this out.
t_text: I'm confiscating this suspicious grain, Perelli. We were looking for signs of tampered food, and it would be in your best interest to stay put while Prince Arthas checks this out.

w_text: We'll see about that, Perelli. We'll see about that.
t_text: We'll see about that, Perelli. We'll see about that.

w_text: Oh hello, Jena. Of course you can borrow some grain. Help yourself.
t_text: Oh hello, Jena. Of course you can borrow some grain. Help yourself.

w_text: Oh, my.
t_text: Oh, my.

w_text: Let's see, we had chicken last night.
t_text: Let's see, we had chicken last night.

w_text: I've got plenty of cured bacon, but he had some for breakfast.
t_text: I've got plenty of cured bacon, but he had some for breakfast.

w_text: I need to make something healthy for him, he's still not recovered from that illness from last week.
t_text: I need to make something healthy for him, he's still not recovered from that illness from last week.

w_text: Strawberries! Oh wait, they're not in season.
t_text: Strawberries! Oh wait, they're not in season.

w_text: Ah, I'll make him some fresh bread! I need to get some flour from Martha!
t_text: Ah, I'll make him some fresh bread! I need to get some flour from Martha!

w_text: Martha, I'm out of flour for bread. You wouldn't happen to have any grain from that recent shipment, would you?
t_text: Martha, I'm out of flour for bread. You wouldn't happen to have any grain from that recent shipment, would you?

w_text: Thanks, Martha! I owe you one.
t_text: Thanks, Martha! I owe you one.

w_text: Oh, dear.
t_text: Oh, dear.

w_text: Martha, something's wrong with this grain! Some of the Prince's soldiers were looking for this. I'm going to go look for one.
t_text: Martha, something's wrong with this grain! Some of the Prince's soldiers were looking for this. I'm going to go look for one.

w_text: Off we go!
t_text: Off we go!

w_text: Here ya go, friend! Icehammer is right inside that vrykul building! Give 'em hell!
t_text: Here ya go, friend! Icehammer is right inside that vrykul building! Give 'em hell!

w_text: For Dalaran! Attack!
t_text: For Dalaran! Attack!

w_text: Looks like a storm's coming in, Scruffy...
t_text: Looks like a storm's coming in, Scruffy...

w_text: What's wrong, pal?
t_text: What's wrong, pal?

w_text: What did you find, boy?
t_text: What did you find, boy?

w_text: This is no good, Scruffy. Stay here and guard the house, I need to go find a soldier.
t_text: This is no good, Scruffy. Stay here and guard the house, I need to go find a soldier.

w_text: %s begins to growl...
t_text: %s begins to growl...

w_text: Hey there, $n, don't be alarmed. It's me... you... from the future.  I'm here to help.
t_text: Hey there, $n, don't be alarmed. It's me... you... from the future.  I'm here to help.

w_text: Heads up... here they come. I'll help as much as I can. Let's just keep them off of the hourglass!
t_text: Heads up... here they come. I'll help as much as I can. Let's just keep them off of the hourglass!

w_text: I can't believe that I used to wear that.
t_text: I can't believe that I used to wear that.

w_text: Look at you fight; no wonder I turned to drinking.
t_text: Look at you fight; no wonder I turned to drinking.

w_text: What? Am I here alone. We both have a stake in this, you know!
t_text: What? Am I here alone. We both have a stake in this, you know!

w_text: No matter what, you can't die, because that would mean that I would cease to exist, right? But, I was here before when I was you. I'm so confused!
t_text: No matter what, you can't die, because that would mean that I would cease to exist, right? But, I was here before when I was you. I'm so confused!

w_text: Wow, I'd forgotten how inexperienced I used to be.
t_text: Wow, I'd forgotten how inexperienced I used to be.

w_text: Sorry, but Chromie said that I couldn't reveal anything about your future to you. She said that if I did, I would cease to exist.
t_text: Sorry, but Chromie said that I couldn't reveal anything about your future to you. She said that if I did, I would cease to exist.

w_text: Wish I could remember how many of the Infinite Dragonflight were going to try to stop you. This fight was so long ago.
t_text: Wish I could remember how many of the Infinite Dragonflight were going to try to stop you. This fight was so long ago.

w_text: Listen. I'm not supposed to tell you this, but there's going to be this party that you're invited to. Whatever you do, DO NOT DRINK THE PUNCH!
t_text: Listen. I'm not supposed to tell you this, but there's going to be this party that you're invited to. Whatever you do, DO NOT DRINK THE PUNCH!

w_text: Ok, enough work for now. Time for refreshments and a little conversation in the inn.
t_text: Ok, enough work for now. Time for refreshments and a little conversation in the inn.

w_text: Wait, what's that smell?
t_text: Wait, what's that smell?

w_text: Can't be me, I took a bath 3 days ago!
t_text: Can't be me, I took a bath 3 days ago!

w_text: Oh, close call. It's just the grain here.
t_text: Oh, close call. It's just the grain here.

w_text: Wait a second. Grain isn't supposed to smell like THAT! I better go find a guard.
t_text: Wait a second. Grain isn't supposed to smell like THAT! I better go find a guard.

w_text: I'm going to lose my on time bonus because of this!
t_text: I'm going to lose my on time bonus because of this!

w_text: I wasn't even supposed to be here today!
t_text: I wasn't even supposed to be here today!

w_text: Well, guess I should load everything back into the cart.
t_text: Well, guess I should load everything back into the cart.

w_text: Oh, come on! My cart broke, my horse lost a shoe, and now the cargo goes bad!
t_text: Oh, come on! My cart broke, my horse lost a shoe, and now the cargo goes bad!

w_text: I guess I'll go find the authorities. If I'm lucky they'll tell me it's the plague and that we're all going to die.
t_text: I guess I'll go find the authorities. If I'm lucky they'll tell me it's the plague and that we're all going to die.

w_text: All soldiers of Lordaeron should immediately report to the entrance of Stratholme, and await further orders from Prince Arthas.
t_text: All soldiers of Lordaeron should immediately report to the entrance of Stratholme, and await further orders from Prince Arthas.

w_text: Scourge forces have been spotted near the King's Square fountain!
t_text: Scourge forces have been spotted near the King's Square fountain!

w_text: Scourge forces have been spotted near the Market Row Gate!
t_text: Scourge forces have been spotted near the Market Row Gate!

w_text: Scourge forces have been spotted near the Festival Lane Gate!
t_text: Scourge forces have been spotted near the Festival Lane Gate!

w_text: Scourge forces have been spotted near the Elder's Square Gate!
t_text: Scourge forces have been spotted near the Elder's Square Gate!

w_text: Scourge forces have been spotted near the Town Hall!
t_text: Scourge forces have been spotted near the Town Hall!

w_text: I have arrived. Shall we set to work, then?
t_text: I have arrived. Shall we set to work, then?

w_text: Ah, more essence to capture...
t_text: Ah, more essence to capture...

w_text: Here is your share.
t_text: Here is your share.

w_text: Good work with the crates! Come talk to me in front of Stratholme for your next assignment!
t_text: Good work with the crates! Come talk to me in front of Stratholme for your next assignment!

w_text: Come over here time traveller, we need to talk!
t_text: Come over here time traveller, we need to talk!

w_text: Quick, over here!
t_text: Quick, over here!

w_text: We meet again, time traveller!
t_text: We meet again, time traveller!

w_text: Hang on to your hat, $n! To Scalawag we go!
t_text: Hang on to your hat, $n! To Scalawag we go!

w_text: YAAARRRRR! Here we be, matey! Scalawag Point!
t_text: YAAARRRRR! Here we be, matey! Scalawag Point!

w_text: You can leave my sight, squire, before I slay you. Again.
t_text: You can leave my sight, squire, before I slay you. Again.

w_text: No. Away with you, worm.
t_text: No. Away with you, worm.

w_text: Get away from me, Edwards, lest I behead you.
t_text: Get away from me, Edwards, lest I behead you.

w_text: Enjoy the ride! It's a one way trip!
t_text: Enjoy the ride! It's a one way trip!

w_text: Kill them Abbendis! Do not fail me!
t_text: Kill them Abbendis! Do not fail me!

w_text: The grand admiral studies you a moment through narrowed eyes.
t_text: The grand admiral studies you a moment through narrowed eyes.

w_text: You served your purpose.
t_text: You served your purpose.

w_text: I will see you weaklings in Icecrown... if you live that long!
t_text: I will see you in Icecrown, weakling... if you live that long!

w_text: You shouldn't have come... now you will die!
t_text: You shouldn't have come... now you will die!

w_text: Why must it be this way?
t_text: Why must it be this way?

w_text: You had it coming!
t_text: You had it coming!

w_text: My burden grows heavier...
t_text: My burden grows heavier...

w_text: This is your fault!

w_text: You're going to have to pick it up, or this isn't going to be much of a competition.
t_text: You're going to have to pick it up, or this isn't going to be much of a competition.

w_text: Ha! 16! How many've you got? 10, maybe 11 if you're lucky?

t_text: None but the blue dragonflight are welcome here. Perhaps this is the work of Alexstrasza? Well, then, she has sent you to your deaths!

t_text: What could you hope to accomplish? To storm brazenly into my domain... to employ magic... against ME?

t_text: I am without limits here. The rules of your cherished reality do not apply. In this realm, I am in control!

t_text: My patience has reached its limit. I will be rid of you!

w_text: You will not succeed while I draw breath!
t_text: You will not succeed while I draw breath!

w_text: Your stupidity has finally caught up with you!
t_text: Your stupidity has finally caught up with you!

t_text: The death of the High Inquisitor of New Avalon will not go unnoticed. You need to get out of here at once! Go, before more of them show up. I'll be fine on my own.

t_text: But in death... We are the children of the damned. The orphaned sons and daughters of the Scourge.

w_text: The shape wasn't mine, of course.  And had you not been so reckless, you would've seen past my illusion.  But you came through for me, and for that... I must thank you!

w_text: Years back, my father and several other frostborn were returning from a trek across Dragonblight. There was a heavy blizzard... far worse than we've ever seen since.
t_text: Years back, my father and several other frostborn were returning from a trek across Dragonblight. There was a heavy blizzard... far worse than we've ever seen since.

w_text: They crossed a trail of blood-soaked snow and followed it to find a dwarf wandering and speaking in a dialect they couldn't make out... and not a dwarf of our kind mind you, but a mountain dwarf - something our kind had never seen before.
t_text: They crossed a trail of blood-soaked snow and followed it to find a dwarf wandering and speaking in a dialect they couldn't make out... and not a dwarf of our kind mind you, but a mountain dwarf - something our kind had never seen before.

w_text: The dwarf seemed lost, having no memory of where he came from, or even of his own name. Not being the kind to leave a dwarven cousin to die in the snow, my father's party took him in and continued back towards Frosthold.
t_text: The dwarf seemed lost, having no memory of where he came from, or even of his own name. Not being the kind to leave a dwarven cousin to die in the snow, my father's party took him in and continued back towards Frosthold.

w_text: Not long later, out of nowhere, the snow burst before them and a jormungar the size of Veranus herself came down upon their party... one of them was swallowed whole before they even had time to react.
t_text: Not long later, out of nowhere, the snow burst before them and a jormungar the size of Veranus herself came down upon their party... one of them was swallowed whole before they even had time to react.

w_text: My father thought they were all doomed... but behind him, a furious roar rumbled across the snow, and he turned to see the mountain dwarf growing in size, his skin taking on a stone-like texture, and his hands sizzling with lightning.

t_text: The dwarf barreled forward with a sound like rolling thunder and hurled a shining metal hammer, lightning coursing over its surface, directly into the jormungar's throat.

w_text: The jormungar collapsed instantly, its head barely still attached to its convulsing body.  My father turned to the dwarf in awe and raised a fist in praise...

w_text: The stranger having no name of his own, my father deemed "Yorg," a name reserved for champions of legend. Years later, he now stands before us as Yorg Stormheart, King of the Frostborn.

w_text: And as one of the fiercest tests put upon a warrior of the frostborn, we are made to face a creature far larger than ourselves--giants, dragons, jormungar--as a testament to the fact that size will never be our weakness.

t_text: Aye, I know. I watched him turn... I watched him give up all that was right and I didn't lift a hand... I didn't even consider it until it was too late.

w_text: No... no they won't. But I can make this right... I have te. I'm goin' after the boy. I'll make'm answer for everything he's done.

t_text: Go Brann. Bring back an epic tale when we meet again. Farewell for now, brothers...

t_text: You've come for the doctor's plans! You'll only find death!

t_text: Are you sure Muradin? I just got you back after years of thinking you were dead. I do not want to lose you again.

w_text: This resolution pains me deeply, but the destruction, the monumental loss of life had to end. Regardless of Malygos' recent transgressions, I will mourn his loss. He was once a guardian, a protector. This day, one of the world's mightiest has fallen.

w_text: I said, SEARCH the bodies BEFORE you eat them!

w_text: Leave no stone unturned. I mean that literally, you heaps of decay! Tear this place apart if you have to.

w_text: What can you tell me, Keynira?

w_text: That's all you've got for me? I want numbers, locations, intentions - we're as good as blind. Get back out in the field!

w_text: We did it, lads! We got here before Algalon's arrival. Maybe we can rig the systems to interfere with his analysis--
t_text: We did it, lads! We got here before Algalon's arrival. Maybe we can rig the systems to interfere with his analysis--

w_text: I'll head back to the Archivum and see if I can jam his signal. I might be able to buy us some time while you take care of him.
t_text: I'll head back to the Archivum and see if I can jam his signal. I might be able to buy us some time while you take care of him.

w_text: I know just the place. Will you be all right?
t_text: I know just the place. Will you be all right?

w_text: Thank you all for attending this sermon. It's wonderful to see so many familiar faces!
t_text: Thank you all for attending this sermon. It's wonderful to see so many familiar faces!

w_text: Today I would like to touch on the three virtues of the Light.
t_text: Today I would like to touch on the three virtues of the Light.

w_text: These are dark and difficult times for us all. The armies of the Scourge amass to the south. Companions fall on the battlefield and rise to serve our enemy moments later.
t_text: These are dark and difficult times for us all. The armies of the Scourge amass to the south. Companions fall on the battlefield and rise to serve our enemy moments later.

w_text: Many of you have experienced a betrayal of trust.
t_text: Many of you have experienced a betrayal of trust.

w_text: Yet you persevere, as we all must. In these times, no one is a stranger to the virtue of tenacity. In the face of despair and hatred, we continue to stand true to our beliefs and fight on.
t_text: Yet you persevere, as we all must. In these times, no one is a stranger to the virtue of tenacity. In the face of despair and hatred, we continue to stand true to our beliefs and fight on.

w_text: There can be no doubt as to your tenacity... but there are other virtues to consider.
t_text: There can be no doubt as to your tenacity... but there are other virtues to consider.

w_text: Respect is the first virtue taught to those joining the path of the Light.
t_text: Respect is the first virtue taught to those joining the path of the Light.

w_text: Look across the aisle to those you would call enemy. Despite the hatred that separates you, there are qualities to respect in your opponent. Their prowess should be acknowledged.
t_text: Look across the aisle to those you would call enemy. Despite the hatred that separates you, there are qualities to respect in your opponent. Their prowess should be acknowledged.

w_text: All of us gathered here have a concept of honorable combat. Conducting yourself with honor and treating your opponent as you wish to be treated shows respect.
t_text: All of us gathered here have a concept of honorable combat. Conducting yourself with honor and treating your opponent as you wish to be treated shows respect.

w_text: Respect your opponent on the field, whether he be your brother or your sworn enemy. No matter where your beliefs truly lie, such respect is acknowledging a connection...
t_text: Respect your opponent on the field, whether he be your brother or your sworn enemy. No matter where your beliefs truly lie, such respect is acknowledging a connection...

w_text: ...and in acknowledging those connections, you are closer to the Light.
t_text: ...and in acknowledging those connections, you are closer to the Light.

w_text: There is one further step on the path of Light: compassion.
t_text: There is one further step on the path of Light: compassion.

w_text: Rivalries abound in this day and age. It is easy to see differences wherever you turn.
t_text: Rivalries abound in this day and age. It is easy to see differences wherever you turn.

w_text: The challenge is in looking beyond appearances and understanding our similarities. Through this understanding, you can feel compassion for the losses others have suffered...
t_text: The challenge is in looking beyond appearances and understanding our similarities. Through this understanding, you can feel compassion for the losses others have suffered...

w_text: ...even if the victim bears another banner.
t_text: ...even if the victim bears another banner.

w_text: By feeling and understanding compassion in enemy and ally alike, you reaffirm your connection with the world.
t_text: By feeling and understanding compassion in enemy and ally alike, you reaffirm your connection with the world.

w_text: Acting on these tenets, these virtues, help make the world a place we all can appreciate. A world of honor and justice.
t_text: Acting on these tenets, these virtues, help make the world a place we all can appreciate. A world of honor and justice.

w_text: Think on my words, friends. In the darkness that surrounds us all, the Light is needed more than ever.
t_text: Think on my words, friends. In the darkness that surrounds us all, the Light is needed more than ever.

w_text: I'll be behind the confessional screen if anyone wishes to speak with me. Any doubts, any worries, any uncertainties I will happily soothe.
t_text: I'll be behind the confessional screen if anyone wishes to speak with me. Any doubts, any worries, any uncertainties I will happily soothe.

w_text: Take heart. Size isn't what matters, but how you use the skills you have.
t_text: Take heart. Size isn't what matters, but how you use the skills you have.

w_text: What you lack in size you make up for in ambition and dedication, little one. Go with the Light.
t_text: What you lack in size you make up for in ambition and dedication, little one. Go with the Light.

w_text: Drink in moderation, then, my dwarven friend, but you may want to turn in your lance and reins for the time being. Go with the Light.
t_text: Drink in moderation, then, my dwarven friend, but you may want to turn in your lance and reins for the time being. Go with the Light.

w_text: I understand your frustration. Your people are ferocious in battle, and this isn't what you're used to.
t_text: I understand your frustration. Your people are ferocious in battle, and this isn't what you're used to.

w_text: But this is a different sort of honorable combat. Difficult to adapt to, perhaps, but with your prowess I'm sure you'll show everyone the strength in your people.
t_text: But this is a different sort of honorable combat. Difficult to adapt to, perhaps, but with your prowess I'm sure you'll show everyone the strength in your people.

w_text: Besides... while an axe can be a valuable tool in war, lances have their uses as well.
t_text: Besides... while an axe can be a valuable tool in war, lances have their uses as well.

w_text: It may seem pointless, but try to find pride in a good fight. The time will come when all this practicing and competition will be put to good use.
t_text: It may seem pointless, but try to find pride in a good fight. The time will come when all this practicing and competition will be put to good use.

w_text: And your hair looks wonderful.
t_text: And your hair looks wonderful.

w_text: Your heart is in the right place, and I know you seek to serve the Light. But these small strikes do little to the great undead host.
t_text: Your heart is in the right place, and I know you seek to serve the Light. But these small strikes do little to the great undead host.

w_text: This tournament is helping to form a strong, concerted force, though it may not appear obvious. When we're ready, the eyes of the Crusade and all its champions will turn toward Icecrown.
t_text: This tournament is helping to form a strong, concerted force, though it may not appear obvious. When we're ready, the eyes of the Crusade and all its champions will turn towards Icecrown.

w_text: We will bring the might of all races to the Lich King, and he will be defeated.
t_text: We will bring the might of all races to the Lich King, and he will be defeated.

w_text: I know this does not seem like the obvious path to you, but it will bring you closer to the Light. Fight well, brother.
t_text: I know this does not seem like the obvious path to you, but it will bring you closer to the Light. Fight well, brother.

w_text: Oh, my. Do you feel remorseful, at least?
t_text: Oh, my. Do you feel remorseful, at least?

w_text: I'd lost all track of time in this forsaken place. You're a sight for sore eyes, friend.
t_text: I'd lost all track of time in this forsaken place. You're a sight for sore eyes, friend.

w_text: Too many of us died in this pit. Far too many.
t_text: Too many of us died in this pit. Far too many.

w_text: I'm so glad you're here. I wouldn't have made it much longer.
t_text: I'm so glad you're here. I wouldn't have made it much longer.

w_text: Now is the time for revenge.
t_text: Now is the time for revenge.

w_text: You deserve a mighty man-hug.
t_text: You deserve a mighty man-hug.

w_text: I will find a way to repay you someday, hero.
t_text: I will find a way to repay you someday, hero.

w_text: I can hardly believe my eyes. Thank you. Really, thank you.
t_text: I can hardly believe my eyes. Thank you. Really, thank you.

t_text: %s nods his thanks.

w_text: %s offers an appreciative smile.
t_text: %s offers an appreciative smile.

w_text: %s almost collapses as he stumbles towards you.
t_text: %s almost collapses as he stumbles towards you.

w_text: %s stares at you for a moment, clearly finding it hard to believe that you're real.
t_text: %s stares at you for a moment, clearly finding it hard to believe that you're real.

w_text: %s offers a quick, cynical laugh at his fortune.
t_text: %s offers a quick, cynical laugh at his fortune.

w_text: %s raises an empty hand in toast to you.

w_text: %s closes his eyes, savoring freedom for a moment.
t_text: %s closes his eyes, savoring freedom for a moment.

w_text: I'm going to return to help free the rest of the slaves.  Thank you again, hero.
t_text: I'm going to return to help free the rest of the slaves.  Thank you again, hero.

w_text: You Sunreaver lackeys are all the same.
t_text: You Sunreaver lackeys are all the same.

w_text: You won't escape from us so easily!
t_text: You won't escape from us so easily!

w_text: Did you think you would escape with your life?
t_text: Did you think you would escape with your life?

w_text: You'll never run us out of the city, Silver Covenant thug!
t_text: You'll never run us out of the city, Silver Covenant thug!

w_text: Heroes, lend me your aid. I... I cannot hold them off much longer. You must heal my wounds!
t_text: Heroes, lend me your aid. I... I cannot hold them off much longer. You must heal my wounds!

w_text: I have opened a portal into the Dream. Your salvation lies within, heroes...
t_text: I have opened a portal into the Dream. Your salvation lies within, heroes...

w_text: My strength is returning. Press on, heroes!
t_text: My strength is returning. Press on, heroes!

w_text: I will not last much longer.
t_text: I will not last much longer.

w_text: Forgive me for what I do! I... cannot... stop... ONLY NIGHTMARES REMAIN!
t_text: Forgive me for what I do! I... cannot... stop... ONLY NIGHTMARES REMAIN!

w_text: A tragic loss...
t_text: A tragic loss...

w_text: FAILURES!
t_text: FAILURES!

w_text: I AM RENEWED! Ysera grant me the favor to lay these foul creatures to rest!
t_text: I AM RENEWED! Ysera grant me the favor to lay these foul creatures to rest!

w_text: Worthless gnat! Death is all that awaits you!
t_text: Worthless gnat! Death is all that awaits you!

w_text: Do not think that I shall permit you entry into my master's sanctum so easily. Pursue me if you dare.
t_text: Do not think that I shall permit you entry into my master's sanctum so easily. Pursue me if you dare.

w_text: Rimefang, trap them within the tunnel! BURY THEM ALIVE!
t_text: Rimefang, trap them within the tunnel! BURY THEM ALIVE!

w_text: Let the Scythe unbind that which was not meant to be bound!  Let the soul master the beast, lest the beast master the soul!
t_text: Let the Scythe unbind that which was not meant to be bound!  Let the soul master the beast, lest the beast master the soul!

w_text: %s becomes enraged!
t_text: %s becomes enraged!

w_text: You have come to bring Arthas to justice? To see the Lich King destroyed?
t_text: You have come to bring Arthas to justice? To see the Lich King destroyed?

w_text: First, you must escape Frostmourne's hold, or be damned as I am; trapped within this cursed blade for all eternity.
t_text: First, you must escape Frostmourne's hold, or be damned as I am; trapped within this cursed blade for all eternity.

w_text: Aid me in destroying these tortured souls! Together we will loosen Frostmourne's hold and weaken the Lich King from within!

w_text: You are fools to have come to this place. The icy winds of Northrend will consume your souls!
t_text: You are fools to have come to this place. The icy winds of Northrend will consume your souls!

w_text: Suffer, mortals, as your pathetic magic betrays you!
t_text: Suffer, mortals, as your pathetic magic betrays you!

t_text: %s prepares to unleash a wave of blistering cold!

w_text: Can you feel the cold hand of death upon your heart?
t_text: Can you feel the cold hand of death upon your heart?

w_text: Aaagh! It burns! What sorcery is this!?
t_text: Aaagh! It burns! What sorcery is this!?

w_text: Your incursion ends here! None shall survive!
t_text: Your incursion ends here! None shall survive!

w_text: Now, feel my master's limitless power and despair!
t_text: Now, feel my master's limitless power and despair!

t_text: %s fires a frozen orb towards $n!

w_text: Perish!
t_text: Perish!

w_text: The flaw of mortality....
t_text: The flaw of mortality....

w_text: Enough! I tire of these games!
t_text: Enough! I tire of these games!

w_text: Free... at last....
t_text: Free... at last....

w_text: %s goes into a berserker rage!
t_text: %s goes into a berserker rage!

w_text: You have found your way here, because you are among the few gifted with true vision in a world cursed with blindness.
t_text: You have found your way here, because you are among the few gifted with true vision in a world cursed with blindness.

w_text: You can see through the fog that hangs over this world like a shroud, and grasp where true power lies.
t_text: You can see through the fog that hangs over this world like a shroud, and grasp where true power lies.

w_text: Fix your eyes upon your crude hands: the sinew, the soft meat, the dark blood coursing within.
t_text: Fix your eyes upon your crude hands: the sinew, the soft meat, the dark blood coursing within.

w_text: It is a weakness; a crippling flaw....  A joke played by the Creators upon their own creations.
t_text: It is a weakness; a crippling flaw....  A joke played by the Creators upon their own creations.

w_text: The sooner you come to accept your condition as a defect, the sooner you will find yourselves in a position to transcend it.
t_text: The sooner you come to accept your condition as a defect, the sooner you will find yourselves in a position to transcend it.

w_text: Through our Master, all things are possible. His power is without limit, and his will unbending.
t_text: Through our Master, all things are possible. His power is without limit, and his will unbending.

w_text: Those who oppose him will be destroyed utterly, and those who serve -- who serve wholly, unquestioningly, with utter devotion of mind and soul -- elevated to heights beyond your ken.
t_text: Those who oppose him will be destroyed utterly, and those who serve -- who serve wholly, unquestioningly, with utter devotion of mind and soul -- elevated to heights beyond your ken.

w_text: What is this disturbance? You dare trespass upon this hallowed ground? This shall be your final resting place!
t_text: What is this disturbance? You dare trespass upon this hallowed ground? This shall be your final resting place!

w_text: Enough! I see I must take matters into my own hands!
t_text: Enough! I see I must take matters into my own hands!

w_text: %s's Mana Barrier shimmers and fades away!
t_text: %s's Mana Barrier shimmers and fades away!

w_text: You are weak, powerless to resist my will!
t_text: You are weak, powerless to resist my will!

w_text: Take this blessing and show these intruders a taste of the Master's power!
t_text: Take this blessing and show these intruders a taste of the Master's power!

w_text: I release you from the curse of flesh!
t_text: I release you from the curse of flesh!

w_text: Arise, and exult in your pure form!
t_text: Arise, and exult in your pure form!

w_text: Do you yet grasp the futility of your actions?
t_text: Do you yet grasp the futility of your actions?

w_text: Embrace the darkness... darkness eternal.
t_text: Embrace the darkness... darkness eternal.

w_text: This charade has gone on long enough!
t_text: This charade has gone on long enough!

w_text: All part of the Master's plan.... Your end is inevitable....
t_text: All part of the Master's plan.... Your end is inevitable....

w_text: You're in luck. I've got just what you need in the load I'm about to wash.
t_text: You're in luck. I've got just what you need in the load I'm about to wash.

w_text: See the piles of laundry and the bucket of water? I'll call out what I need next, and you put it in the tub. Ready?
t_text: See the piles of laundry and the bucket of water? I'll run out what I need next, and you put it in the tub. Ready?

w_text: Quick, add some shirts to the laundry!
t_text: Quick, add some shirts to the laundry!

w_text: Add the unmentionables... uh, I mean, the 'delicates'!
t_text: Add the unmentionables... uh, I mean, the 'delicates'!

w_text: The tub needs more water!
t_text: The tub needs more water!

w_text: Toss some pants in to the tub!
t_text: Toss some pants in to the tub!

w_text: I should keep you around.
t_text: I should keep you around.

w_text: Well done!
t_text: Well done!

w_text: That's how it's done!
t_text: That's how it's done!

w_text: Clean and tidy!
t_text: Clean and tidy!

w_text: Nice. I don't want to know what that stain was.
t_text: Nice. I don't want to know what that stain was.

w_text: Aquanos can hardly keep up!
t_text: Aquanos can hardly keep up!

w_text: Oh, no! That wasn't right. Now I'll have to go get more detergent so we can start over!
t_text: Oh, no! That wasn't right. Now I'll have to go get more detergent so we can start over!

w_text: Aquanos, stop sending the clothes so high! You didn't have to see the look on Aethas Sunreaver's face when he found his pants in the fountain!
t_text: Aquanos, stop sending the clothes so high! You didn't have to see the look on Aethas Sunreaver's face when he found his pants in the fountain!

w_text: See how easy that was with everyone working together? Just take what you need from the clean laundry here, but don't forget to return it when you're finished.

t_text: Release yourself from the chains of life...

w_text: The Lich King is unstoppable...

w_text: Rise up, sons and daughters of the Horde! Today we battle a hated enemy of the Horde! LOK'TAR OGAR!
t_text: Rise up, sons and daughters of the Horde! Today we battle a hated enemy of the Horde! LOK'TAR OGAR!

w_text: Kor'kron, take us out!
t_text: Kor'kron, take us out!

w_text: What is that? Something approaching in the distance.
t_text: What is that? Something approaching in the distance.

w_text: ALLIANCE GUNSHIP! ALL HANDS ON DECK!
t_text: ALLIANCE GUNSHIP! ALL HANDS ON DECK!

w_text: You answer to Saurfang now!
t_text: You answer to Saurfang now!

w_text: You will know our business soon. Kor'kron, ANNIHILATE THEM!
t_text: You will know our business soon. Kor'kron, ANNIHILATE THEM!

w_text: This is not your battle, dwarf. Back down or we will be forced to destroy your ship.
t_text: This is not your battle, dwarf. Back down or we will be forced to destroy your ship.

w_text: You DARE board my ship? Your death will come swiftly.
t_text: You DARE board my ship? Your death will come swiftly.

w_text: Reavers, Sergeants, attack!
t_text: Reavers, Sergeants, attack!

w_text: Axethrowers, hurl faster!
t_text: Axethrowers, hurl faster!

w_text: Rocketeers, reload!
t_text: Rocketeers, reload!

w_text: We're taking hull damage, get a battle-mage out here to shut down those cannons!
t_text: We're taking hull damage, get a battle-mage out here to shut down those cannons!

w_text: The Alliance falter. Onward to the Lich King!
t_text: The Alliance falter. Onward to the Lich King!

w_text: Damage control! Put those fires out. You haven't seen the last of the Horde!
t_text: Damage control! Put those fires out. You haven't seen the last of the Horde!

w_text: Fire up the engines! We got a meetin' with destiny, lads!
t_text: Fire up the engines! We got a meetin' with destiny, lads!

w_text: Hold on to yer hats!
t_text: Hold on to yer hats!

w_text: What in the world is that? Grab me spyglass, crewman!
t_text: What in the world is that? Grab me spyglass, crewman!

w_text: By me own beard! HORDE SAILIN' IN FAST 'N HOT!
t_text: By me own beard! HORDE SAILIN' IN FAST 'N HOT!

w_text: EVASIVE ACTION! MAN THE GUNS!
t_text: EVASIVE ACTION! MAN THE GUNS!

w_text: Cowardly dogs! Ye blindsided us!
t_text: Cowardly dogs! Ye blindsided us!

w_text: Not me battle? I dunnae who ye think ye are, mister, but I got a score to settle with Arthas and yer not gettin' in me way! FIRE ALL GUNS! FIRE! FIRE!
t_text: Not me battle? I dunnae who ye think ye are, mister, but I got a score to settle with Arthas and yer not gettin' in me way! FIRE ALL GUNS! FIRE! FIRE!

w_text: Move yer jalopy or we'll blow it out of the sky, orc! The Horde's got no business here.
t_text: Move yer jalopy or we'll blow it out of the sky, orc! The Horde's got no business here.

w_text: What's this then?! Ye won't be takin' this son o' Ironforge's vessel without a fight!
t_text: What's this then?! Ye won't be takin' this son o' Ironforge's vessel without a fight!

w_text: Marines, Sergeants, attack!
t_text: Marines, Sergeants, attack!

w_text: Riflemen, shoot faster!
t_text: Riflemen, shoot faster!

w_text: Mortar team, reload!
t_text: Mortar team, reload!

w_text: We're taking hull damage, get a sorcerer out here to shut down those cannons!
t_text: We're taking hull damage, get a sorcerer out here to shut down those cannons!

w_text: Don't say I didn't warn ya, scoundrels! Onward, brothers and sisters!
t_text: Don't say I didn't warn ya, scoundrels! Onward, brothers and sisters!

w_text: Captain Bartlett, get us out of here! We're taken too much damage to stay afloat!
t_text: Captain Bartlett, get us out of here! We're taken too much damage to stay afloat!

w_text: Your allies have arrived, Jaina, just as you promised. You will all become powerful agents of the Scourge.
t_text: Your allies have arrived, Jaina, just as you promised. You will all become powerful agents of the Scourge..

w_text: I will not make the same mistake again, Sylvanas. This time there will be no escape. You will all serve me in death!
t_text: I will not make the same mistake again, Sylvanas. This time there will be no escape. You will all serve me in death!

w_text: There is no escape!
t_text: There is no escape!

w_text: Succumb to the chill of the grave.
t_text: Succumb to the chill of the grave.

w_text: Another dead end.
t_text: Another dead end.

w_text: How long can you fight it?
t_text: How long can you fight it?

w_text: Arise minions.  Do not let them pass.
t_text: Arise minions.  Do not let them pass.

w_text: Minions, seize them.  Bring their corpses back to me.
t_text: Minions, sieze them.  Bring their corpses back to me.

w_text: Death's cold embrace awaits.
t_text: Death's cold embrace awaits.

w_text: Nowhere to run... You're mine now!
t_text: Nowhere to run! You're mine now...

w_text: He is too powerful. We must leave this place at once! My magic can hold him in place for only a short time. Come quickly, heroes!
t_text: He is too powerful. We must leave this place at once! My magic can hold him in place for only a short time. Come quickly, heroes!

w_text: I will destroy this barrier. You must hold the undead back!
t_text: I will destroy this barrier. You must hold the undead back!

w_text: Another ice wall! Keep the undead from interrupting my incantations so that I may bring this wall down.
t_text: Another ice wall! Keep the undead from interrupting my incantations so that I may bring this wall down.

w_text: He is toying with us! I will show him what happens to ice when it meets fire!
t_text: He is toying with us! I will show him what happens to ice when it meets fire!

w_text: Your barriers can't hold us back much longer, monster! I will shatter them all!
t_text: Your barriers can't hold us back much longer, monster! I will shatter them all!

w_text: We're almost there... Don't give up!
t_text: We're almost there... Don't give up!

w_text: It... It's a dead end. We have no choice but to fight. Steel yourselves, heroes, for this is our last stand!
t_text: It... It's a dead end. We have no choice but to fight. Steel yourselves, heroes, for this is our last stand!

w_text: Forgive me, heroes. I should have listened to Uther. I... I just had to see for myself. To look into his eyes one last time. I am sorry.
t_text: Forgive me, heroes. I should have listened to Uther. I... I just had to see for myself. To look into his eyes one last time. I am sorry.

w_text: We now know what must be done. I will deliver this news to King Varian and Highlord Fordring.
t_text: We now know what must be done. I will deliver this news to King Varian and Highlord Fordring.

w_text: Why should the Banshee Queen spare your miserable life?
t_text: Why should the Banshee Queen spare your miserable life?

w_text: Frostmourne? The Lich King is never without his blade. If you are lying to me...
t_text: Frostmourne? The Lich King is never without his blade. If you are lying to me...

w_text: A fitting end for a traitor. Come, we must free the slaves and see what is within the Lich King's chamber for ourselves.
t_text: A fitting end for a traitor. Come, we must free the slaves and see what is within the Lich King's chamber for ourselves.

w_text: Take cover behind me! Quickly!
t_text: Take cover behind me! Quickly!

w_text: I thought he'd never shut up. At last, Sindragosa silenced that long-winded fool. To the Halls of Reflection, champions! Our objective is near... I can sense it.
t_text: I thought he'd never shut up. At last, Sindragosa silenced that long-winded fool. To the Halls of Reflection, champions! Our objective is near... I can sense it.

w_text: I'm not so naive as to believe your appeal for clemency, but I will listen.
t_text: I'm not so naive as to believe your appeal for clemency, but I will listen.

w_text: Frostmourne lies unguarded? Impossible!
t_text: Frostmourne lies unguarded? Impossible!

w_text: What a cruel end. Come, heroes. We must see if the gnome's story is true. If we can separate Arthas from Frostmourne, we might have a chance at stopping him.
t_text: What a cruel end. Come, heroes. We must see if the gnome's story is true. If we can separate Arthas from Frostmourne, we might have a chance at stopping him.

w_text: Heroes, to me!
t_text: Heroes, to me!

w_text: The Frost Queen is gone. We must keep moving - our objective is near.
t_text: The Frost Queen is gone. We must keep moving - our objective is near.

w_text: I... I could not save them... Damn you, Arthas! DAMN YOU!
t_text: I... I could not save them... Damn you, Arthas! DAMN YOU!

w_text: The master's sanctum has been disturbed!
t_text: The master's sanctum has been disturbed!

w_text: I... awaken!
t_text: I... awaken!

w_text: Who... goes there...?
t_text: Who... goes there...?

w_text: Just in time, $n.  Here come the Forsaken.
t_text: Just in time, $n.  Here come the Forsaken.

w_text: You will come no further, Forsaken scum!  By the war banner of the ancient Greymane clan, I expel you from our ancestral lands!
t_text: You will come no further, Forsaken scum!  By the war banner of the ancient Greymane clan, I expel you from our ancestral lands!

w_text: You break our cave, I break your skull!
t_text: You break our cave, I break your skull!

w_text: Why you break our home?!
t_text: Why you break our home?!

w_text: Trogg cave all gone!  You pay for this!!
t_text: Trogg cave all gone!  You pay for this!!

w_text: Thanks!  I can make it from here.
t_text: Thanks!  I can make it from here.

w_text: Yer a lifesaver!  For Ironforge!
t_text: Yer a lifesaver!  For Ironforge!

w_text: Ahh, much better.  I owe ya one.
t_text: Ahh, much better.  I owe ya one.

w_text: Get back, ye filthy beast!
t_text: Get back, ye filthy beast!

w_text: Eat dwarven lead!
t_text: Eat dwarven lead!

w_text: For Ironforge!
t_text: For Ironforge!

w_text: Get ta work, boys!
t_text: Get ta work, boys!

w_text: Don't fret, we'll be outta here soon.
t_text: Don't fret, we'll be outta here soon.

w_text: Let's keep this fire going, dwarves!
t_text: Let's keep this fire going, dwarves!

w_text: What's Joren doin' out there, anyhow?
t_text: What's Joren doin' out there, anyhow?

w_text: You gotta hurry, kid. We gotta get you into the game. But first, we gotta get the parts for that shredder!
t_text: You gotta hurry,kid. We gotta get you into the game. But first, we gotta get the parts for that shredder!

w_text: Get into that shredder and win the game. The Bilgewater Cartel's counting on you!
t_text: Get into that shredder and win the game. The Bilgewater Cartel's counting on you!

w_text: You got the juice, kid. That's for sure! Too bad that dragon had to come and ruin everything. No matter. You made us proud. Now get back to headquarters.
t_text: You got the juice,kid. That's for sure! Too bad that dragon had to come and ruin everything. No matter. You made us proud. Now get back to headquarters.

w_text: Da spirits be angry with us.
t_text: Da spirits be angry with us.

w_text: I don' know why the spirits be rejectin' us so.
t_text: I don' know why the spirits be rejectin' us so.

w_text: Don' worry, child.  Grik'nir gonna help us get through this.
t_text: Don' worry, child.  Grik'nir gonna help us get through this.

w_text: I am from the elemental plane!
t_text: I am from the elemental plane!

w_text: I AM FROM THE ELEMENTAL PLANE!
t_text: I AM FROM THE ELEMENTAL PLANE!

w_text: This is our final stand. What happens here will echo through the ages. Regardless of outcome, they will know that we fought with honor. That we fought for the freedom and safety of our people!
