w_text: Our march upon Icecrown Citadel begins now!
t_text: Our march upon Icecrown Citadel begins now!

w_text: ARTHAS! I swore that I would see you dead and the Scourge dismantled! I'm going to finish what I started at Light's Hope!
t_text: ARTHAS! I swore that I would see you dead and the Scourge dismantled! I'm going to finish what I started at Light's Hope!

w_text: The power of the Light knows no bounds, Saurfang. His soul is under great strain, but he lives - for now.
t_text: The power of the Light knows no bounds, Saurfang. His soul is under great strain, but he lives - for now.

w_text: By the Light, it must be so!
t_text: By the Light, it must be so!

w_text: So, it has begun....
t_text: So, it has begun....

w_text: Behold! The binding of sacred and corrupt; the forging of Shadow's Edge, a weapon of untold potential!
t_text: Behold! The binding of sacred and corrupt; the forging of Shadow's Edge, a weapon of untold potential!

w_text: Bend it to your will, and you shall wield unspeakable power!
t_text: Bend it to your will, and you shall wield unspeakable power!

w_text: Fail, and your soul shall forever be its slave.
t_text: Fail, and your soul shall forever be its slave.

w_text: Father...
t_text: Father...

w_text: Father. I feared for your... your sanity.
t_text: Father. I feared for your... your sanity.

w_text: Father... For you, I would give my life a thousand times.
t_text: Father... For you, I would give my life a thousand times.

w_text: Never... could reach... the top shelf...
t_text: Never... could reach... the top shelf...

w_text: You miserable fools never did manage to select a decent bat wing.
t_text: You miserable fools never did manage to select a decent bat wing.

w_text: THAT was for bringing me spoiled spider ichor!
t_text: THAT was for bringing me spoiled spider ichor!

w_text: Don't... let Finklestein use me... for his potions...
t_text: Don't... let Finklestein use me... for his potions...

w_text: The loss of our comrades was unpreventable. They lived and died in the service of the Argent Crusade.
t_text: The loss of our comrades was unpreventable. They lived and died in the service of the Argent Crusade.

w_text: Even dying here beats spending another day collecting reagents for that madman, Finklestein.
t_text: Even dying here beats spending another day collecting reagents for that madman, Finklestein.

w_text: No amount of healing can save me now. Fight on, brothers...
t_text: No amount of healing can save me now. Fight on, brothers...

w_text: What? This strength...? All of the pain is gone! You... must join me in the eternal embrace of death!
t_text: What? This strength...? All of the pain is gone! You... must join me in the eternal embrace of death!

w_text: It doesn't hurt anymore, does it?
t_text: It doesn't hurt anymore, does it?

w_text: I'm sorry...
t_text: I'm sorry...

w_text: You have done much in this war against the Scourge. May the light embrace you.
t_text: You have done much in this war against the Scourge. May the light embrace you.

w_text: Please... burn my remains. Let me live warm in the afterlife...
t_text: Please... burn my remains. Let me live warm in the afterlife...

w_text: No! Why was I denied a death by flame? You must all BURN!
t_text: No! Why was I denied a death by flame? You must all BURN!

w_text: Can you feel the burn?
t_text: Can you feel the burn?

w_text: What... have I done? No!
t_text: What... have I done? No!

w_text: What can possibly redeem this unholy place? Thank you.
t_text: What can possibly redeem this unholy place? Thank you.

w_text: It was... a worthy afterlife.
t_text: It was... a worthy afterlife.

w_text: There is no escaping the Lich King's will. Prepare for an explosive encounter!
t_text: There is no escaping the Lich King's will. Prepare for an explosive encounter!

w_text: So that's what happens what you stand too close to a bomb!
t_text: So that's what happens what you stand too close to a bomb!

w_text: What an... explosive ending!
t_text: What an... explosive ending!

w_text: Beware the dangers that lie ahead... and do try to remain in one piece.
t_text: Beware the dangers that lie ahead... and do try to remain in one piece.

w_text: You may have once fought beside me, Crok, but now you are nothing more than a traitor. Come, your second death approaches!
t_text: You may have once fought beside me, Crok, but now you are nothing more than a traitor. Come, your second death approaches!

w_text: Miserable creatures! Die!
t_text: Miserable creatures! Die!

w_text: Foolish Crok. You brought my reinforcements with you. Arise, Argent Champions, and serve the Lich King in death!
t_text: Foolish Crok. You brought my reinforcements with you. Arise, Argent Champions, and serve the Lich King in death!

w_text: Come, Scourgebane. I'll show the master which of us is truly worthy of the title of "Champion"!
t_text: Come, Scourgebane. I'll show the master which of us is truly worthy of the title of "Champion"!

w_text: What a pitiful choice of an ally, Crok!
t_text: What a pitiful choice of an ally, Crok!

w_text: They died so easily. No matter.
t_text: They died so easily. No matter.

w_text: Perhaps... you were right, Crok.
t_text: Perhaps... you were right, Crok.

w_text: %s has impaled $n!
t_text: %s has impaled $n!

w_text: %s's Aether Shield has been shattered by $n!
t_text: %s's Aether Shield has been shattered by $n!

w_text: Ready your arms, my Argent Brothers. The Vrykul will protect the Frost Queen with their lives.
t_text: Ready your arms, my Argent Brothers. The Vrykul will protect the Frost Queen with their lives.

w_text: Enough idle banter! Our champions have arrived - support them as we push our way through the hall!
t_text: Enough idle banter! Our champions have arrived - support them as we push our way through the hall!

w_text: Draw them back to us, and we'll assist you.
t_text: Draw them back to us, and we'll assist you.

w_text: Quickly, push on!
t_text: Quickly, push on!

w_text: Her reinforcements will arrive shortly, we must bring her down quickly!
t_text: Her reinforcements will arrive shortly, we must bring her down quickly!

w_text: I'll draw her attacks. Return our brothers to their graves, then help me bring her down!
t_text: I'll draw her attacks. Return our brothers to their graves, then help me bring her down!

w_text: Augh! I must rest for a moment.
t_text: Augh! I must rest for a moment.

w_text: Champions! I cannot hold her back any longer.
t_text: Champions! I cannot hold her back any longer.

w_text: Vengeance alone... was not enough!
t_text: Vengeance alone... was not enough!

w_text: Guards! I expect this $r to be clapped into chains!
t_text: Guards!I expect this $r to be clapped into chains!

w_text: %s prepares to attack!
t_text: %s prepares to attack!

w_text: %s becomes enraged!
t_text: %s becomes enraged!

w_text: You know, that does smell pretty... Hey! Stop spraying that thing at me!
t_text: You know, that does smell pretty... Hey! Stop spraying that thing at me!

w_text: Don't tempt me! Do you even know what's in those things?
t_text: Don't tempt me! Do you even know what's in those things?

w_text: What we gon' do now, you ask?  We wait.
t_text: What we gon' do now, you ask?  We wait.

w_text: Grik'nir says he gon' talk to the elemental, get it to fight on our side.
t_text: Grik'nir says he gon' talk to the elemental, get it to fight on our side.

w_text: Soon enough we take over dis valley.  Soon enough.
t_text: Soon enough we take over dis valley.  Soon enough.

w_text: Our land be a land of ice an' snow.
t_text: Our land be a land of ice an' snow.

w_text: But beneath the earth, child, there always be fire.
t_text: But beneath the earth, child, there always be fire.

w_text: De spirit come from deep down to talk with Grik'nir.
t_text: De spirit come from deep down to talk with Grik'nir.

w_text: You now stand upon the hallowed ground of the Scourge. The Light won't protect you here, paladin. Nothing will protect you...
t_text: You now stand upon the hallowed ground of the Scourge. The Light won't protect you here, paladin. Nothing will protect you...

w_text: You could have been my greatest champion, Fordring: A force of darkness that would wash over this world and deliver it into a new age of strife.
t_text: You could have been my greatest champion, Fordring: A force of darkness that would wash over this world and deliver it into a new age of strife.

w_text: But that honor is no longer yours. Soon, I will have a new champion.
t_text: But that honor is no longer yours. Soon, I will have a new champion.

w_text: The breaking of this one has been taxing. The atrocities I have committed upon his soul. He has resisted for so long, but he will bow down before his king soon.
t_text: The breaking of this one has been taxing. The atrocities I have committed upon his soul. He has resisted for so long, but he will bow down before his king soon.

w_text: In the end, you will all serve me.
t_text: In the end, you will all serve me.

w_text: NEVER! I... I will never... serve... you...
t_text: NEVER! I... I will never... serve... you...

w_text: Rocket Pack Active!
t_text: Rocket Pack Active!

w_text: Rocket Pack Disabled. Move closer to Zafod Boombox to re-activate.
t_text: Rocket Pack Disabled. Move closer to Zafod Boombox to re-activate.

w_text: Kor'kron, move out! Champions, watch your backs. The Scourge have been...
t_text: Kor'kron, move out! Champions, watch your backs. The Scourge have been...

w_text: My boy died at the Wrath Gate. I am here only to collect his body.
t_text: My boy died at the Wrath Gate. I am here only to collect his body.

w_text: We named him Dranosh - It means "Heart of Draenor" in orcish. I would not let the warlocks take him. My boy would be safe, hidden away by the elders of Garadar.
t_text: We named him Dranosh - It means "Heart of Draenor" in orcish. I would not let the warlocks take him. My boy would be safe, hidden away by the elders of Garadar.

w_text: I made a promise to his mother before she died; that I would cross the Dark Portal alone - whether I lived or died, my son would be safe. Untainted...
t_text: I made a promise to his mother before she died; that I would cross the Dark Portal alone - whether I lived or died, my son would be safe. Untainted...

w_text: Today, I fulfill that promise.
t_text: Today, I fulfill that promise.

w_text: %s charges!
t_text: %s charges!

w_text: Behind you lies the body of my only son. Nothing will keep me from him.
t_text: Behind you lies the body of my only son. Nothing will keep me from him.

w_text: High Overlord Saurfang walks over to his son and kneels before his son's body.
t_text: High Overlord Saurfang walks over to his son and kneels before his son's body.

w_text: [Orcish] No'ku kil zil'nok ha tar.
t_text: [Orcish] No'ku kil zil'nok ha tar.

w_text: Higher Overlord Saurfang picks up the body of his son and walks over towards Varian
t_text: Higher Overlord Saurfang picks up the body of his son and walks over towards Varian

w_text: I will not forget this... kindness. I thank you, Highness
t_text: I will not forget this... kindness. I thank you, Highness

w_text: %s coughs.
t_text: %s coughs.

w_text: %s weeps over the corpse of his son.
t_text: %s weeps over the corpse of his son.

w_text: You will have a proper ceremony in Nagrand, next to the pyres of your mother and ancestors.
t_text: You will have a proper ceremony in Nagrand, next to the pyres of your mother and ancestors.

w_text: Honor, young heroes... no matter how dire the battle... never forsake it.
t_text: Honor, young heroes... no matter how dire the battle... never forsake it.

w_text: The paladin still lives? Is it possible, Highlord? Could he have survived?
t_text: The paladin still lives? Is it possible, Highlord? Could he have survived?

w_text: Then we must save him! If we rescue Bolvar Fordragon, we may quell the unrest between the Alliance and the Horde.
t_text: Then we must save him! If we rescue Bolvar Fordragon, we may quell the unrest between the Alliance and the Horde.

w_text: Our mission is now clear: The Lich King will answer for his crimes and we will save Highlord Bolvar Fordragon!
t_text: Our mission is now clear: The Lich King will answer for his crimes and we will save Highlord Bolvar Fordragon!

w_text: Kor'kron, prepare Orgrim's Hammer for its final voyage! Champions, our gunship will find a point to dock on the upper reaches of the citadel. Meet us there!
t_text: Kor'kron, prepare Orgrim's Hammer for its final voyage! Champions, our gunship will find a point to dock on the upper reaches of the citadel. Meet us there!

w_text: %s cries.
t_text: %s cries.

w_text: It was nothing, your majesty. Just... I'm proud of my king.
t_text: It was nothing, your majesty. Just... I'm proud of my king.

w_text: Get our men in position immediately, Tobias.  We cannot let the Scythe fall into the hands of the Forsaken!!
t_text: Get our men in position immediately, Tobias.  We cannot let the Scythe fall into the hands of the Forsaken!!

w_text: Lorna!
t_text: Lorna!

w_text: Does this toad speak for you, Genn?  Do you come to our dwelling as a friend?  Or do you come as a tyrant?
t_text: Does this toad speak for you, Genn?  Do you come to our dwelling as a friend?  Or do you come as a tyrant?

w_text: Aye, Genn.  It is not law that binds us.  It is something far stronger.  My men are ready to give their lives under your command.
t_text: Aye, Genn.  It is not law that binds us.  It is something far stronger.  My men are ready to give their lives under your command.

w_text: Let's get a move on then! Move ou...
t_text: Let's get a move on then! Move ou...

w_text: A lone orc against the might of the Alliance???
t_text: A lone orc against the might of the Alliance???

w_text: Charge!!!
t_text: Charge!!!

w_text: %s gasps for air.
t_text: %s gasps for air.

w_text: That was Saurfang's boy - the Horde commander at the Wrath Gate. Such a tragic end...
t_text: That was Saurfang's boy - the Horde commander at the Wrath Gate. Such a tragic end...

w_text: What in the... There, in the distance!
t_text: What in the... There, in the distance!

w_text: A Horde Zeppelin flies up to the rise.
t_text: A Horde Zeppelin flies up to the rise.

w_text: Soldiers, fall in! Looks like the Horde are comin' to take another shot!
t_text: Soldiers, fall in! Looks like the Horde are comin' to take another shot!

w_text: The Zeppelin docks, and High Overlord Saurfang hops out, confronting the Alliance soldiers and Muradin
t_text: The Zeppelin docks, and High Overlord Saurfang hops out, confronting the Alliance soldiers and Muradin

w_text: Don't force me hand, orc. We can't let ye pass.
t_text: Don't force me hand, orc. We can't let ye pass.

w_text: I... I can't do it. Get back on yer ship and we'll spare yer life.
t_text: I... I can't do it. Get back on yer ship and we'll spare yer life.

w_text: A mage portal from Stormwind appears between the two and Varian Wrynn and Jaina Proudmoore emerge.
t_text: A mage portal from Stormwind appears between the two and Varian Wrynn and Jaina Proudmoore emerge.

w_text: Right away, yer majesty!
t_text: Right away, yer majesty!

w_text: Could it be, Lord Fordring? If Bolvar lives, mayhap there is hope fer peace between the Alliance and the Horde. We must reach the top o' this cursed place and free the paladin!
t_text: Could it be, Lord Fordring? If Bolvar lives, mayhap there is hope fer peace between the Alliance and the Horde. We must reach the top o' this cursed place and free the paladin!

w_text: Prepare the Skybreaker fer an aerial assault on the citadel!
t_text: Prepare the Skybreaker fer an aerial assault on the citadel!

w_text: Heroes, ye must fight yer way to a clear extraction point within Icecrown. We'll try an' rendezvous on the ramparts!
t_text: Heroes, ye must fight yer way to a clear extraction point within Icecrown. We'll try an' rendezvous on the ramparts!

w_text: We must defend the Sunwell from the enemy at all costs.
t_text: We must defend the Sunwell from the enemy at all costs.

w_text: I am ordering you to withdraw to the Sunwell proper to help prepare the defenses.
t_text: I am ordering you to withdraw to the Sunwell proper to help prepare the defenses.

w_text: I will make my stand here and buy you as much time as I am able. Use it well and make our prince proud.
t_text: I will make my stand here and buy you as much time as I am able. Use it well and make our prince proud.

w_text: It has been a great honor to fight beside you in defense of our land and our people.
t_text: It has been a great honor to fight beside you in defense of our land and our people.

w_text: You, stranger... you are not one of my soldiers. Will you stay and stand with me to face the enemy?
t_text: You, stranger... you are not one of my soldiers. Will you stay and stand with me to face the enemy?

w_text: Listen well, Scourge defilers. None of you will reach the Sunwell so long as I stand!
t_text: Listen well, Scourge defilers. None of you will reach the Sunwell so long as I stand!

w_text: I... I wasn't meant to survive this attack.
t_text: I... I wasn't meant to survive this attack.

w_text: Why has this happened? Why have you come here?
t_text: Why has this happened? Why have you come here?

w_text: It's Quel'Delar! You possess the sword!
t_text: It's Quel'Delar! You possess the sword!

w_text: I don't know how, but the blade has chosen you to be its new wielder. Take it with my blessing, and wield it against the Scourge as I once did.
t_text: I don't know how, but the blade has chosen you to be its new wielder. Take it with my blessing, and wield it against the Scourge as I once did.

w_text: %s cries out with a loud, baying howl!
t_text: %s cries out with a loud, baying howl!

w_text: The chill of this place... I can feel my blood freezing.
t_text: The chill of this place... I can feel my blood freezing.

w_text: What is that! Up ahead! Could it be? Heroes, at my side!
t_text: What is that! Up ahead! Could it be? Heroes, at my side!

w_text: Frostmourne: the blade that destroyed our kingdom...
t_text: Frostmourne: the blade that destroyed our kingdom...

w_text: Stand back! Touch that blade and your soul will be scarred for all eternity! I must attempt to commune with the spirits locked away within Frostmourne. Give me space. Back up, please.
t_text: Stand back! Touch that blade and your soul will be scarred for all eternity! I must attempt to commune with the spirits locked away within Frostmourne. Give me space. Back up, please.

w_text: Uther! Dear Uther! I... I'm so sorry.
t_text: Uther! Dear Uther! I... I'm so sorry.

w_text: Arthas is here? Maybe I...
t_text: Arthas is here? Maybe I...

w_text: But Uther, if there's any hope of reaching Arthas. I... I must try.
t_text: But Uther, if there's any hope of reaching Arthas. I... I must try.

w_text: Tell me how, Uther? How do I destroy my prince? My...
t_text: Tell me how, Uther? How do I destroy my prince? My...

w_text: You're right, Uther. Forgive me. I... I don't know what got a hold of me. We will deliver this information to the King and the knights that battle the Scourge within Icecrown Citadel.
t_text: You're right, Uther. Forgive me. I... I don't know what got a hold of me. We will deliver this information to the King and the knights that battle the Scourge within Icecrown Citadel.

w_text: Who could bear such a burden?
t_text: Who could bear such a burden?

w_text: Then maybe there is still hope...
t_text: Then maybe there is still hope...

w_text: You won't deny me this, Arthas! I must know... I must find out...
t_text: You won't deny me this, Arthas! I must know... I must find out...

w_text: I... I don't believe it! Frostmourne stands before us - unguarded - just as the gnome claimed. Come, heroes!
t_text: I... I don't believe it! Frostmourne stands before us - unguarded - just as the gnome claimed. Come, heroes!

w_text: Standing this close to the blade that ended my life... The pain... It is renewed.
t_text: Standing this close to the blade that ended my life... The pain... It is renewed.

w_text: I dare not touch it. Stand back! Stand back as I attempt to commune with the blade! Perhaps our salvation lies within...
t_text: I dare not touch it. Stand back! Stand back as I attempt to commune with the blade! Perhaps our salvation lies within...

w_text: Uther... Uther the Lightbringer. How...
t_text: Uther... Uther the Lightbringer. How...

w_text: The Lich King is here? Then my destiny shall be fulfilled on this day!
t_text: The Lich King is here? Then my destiny shall be fulfilled on this day!

w_text: There must be a way...
t_text: There must be a way...

w_text: The Frozen Throne...
t_text: The Frozen Throne...

w_text: You will not escape me that easily, Arthas! I will have my vengeance!
t_text: You will not escape me that easily, Arthas! I will have my vengeance!

w_text: Jaina! Could it truly be you?
t_text: Jaina! Could it truly be you?

w_text: Jaina, you haven't much time. The Lich King sees what the sword sees. He will be here shortly.
t_text: Jaina, you haven't much time. The Lich King sees what the sword sees. He will be here shortly.

w_text: No, girl. Arthas is not here. Arthas is merely a presence within the Lich King's mind. A dwindling presence...
t_text: No, girl. Arthas is not here. Arthas is merely a presence within the Lich King's mind. A dwindling presence...

w_text: Jaina, listen to me. You must destroy the Lich King. You cannot reason with him. He will kill you and your allies and raise you all as powerful soldiers of the Scourge.
t_text: Jaina, listen to me. You must destroy the Lich King. You cannot reason with him. He will kill you and your allies and raise you all as powerful soldiers of the Scourge.

w_text: Snap out of it, girl. You must destroy the Lich King at the place where he merged with Ner'zhul - atop the spire, at the Frozen Throne. It is the only way.
t_text: Snap out of it, girl. You must destroy the Lich King at the place where he merged with Ner'zhul - atop the spire, at the Frozen Throne. It is the only way.

w_text: There is... something else that you should know about the Lich King. Control over the Scourge must never be lost. Even if you were to strike down the Lich King, another would have to take his place. For without the control of its master, the Scourge would run rampant across the world - destroying all living things.
t_text: There is... something else that you should know about the Lich King. Control over the Scourge must never be lost. Even if you were to strike down the Lich King, another would have to take his place. For without the control of its master, the Scourge would run rampant across the world - destroying all living things.

w_text: A grand sacrifice by a noble soul...
t_text: A grand sacrifice by a noble soul...

w_text: I do not know, Jaina. I suspect that the piece of Arthas that might be left inside the Lich King is all that holds the Scourge from annihilating Azeroth.
t_text: I do not know, Jaina. I suspect that the piece of Arthas that might be left inside the Lich King is all that holds the Scourge from annihilating Azeroth.

w_text: No, Jaina! ARRRRRRGHHHH... He... He is coming. You... You must...
t_text: No, Jaina! ARRRRRRGHHHH... He... He is coming. You... You must...

w_text: Careful, girl. I've heard talk of that cursed blade saving us before. Look around you and see what has been born of Frostmourne.
t_text: Careful, girl. I've heard talk of that cursed blade saving us before. Look around you and see what has been born of Frostmourne.

w_text: You haven't much time. The Lich King sees what the sword sees. He will be here shortly.
t_text: You haven't much time. The Lich King sees what the sword sees. He will be here shortly.

w_text: You cannot defeat the Lich King. Not here. You would be a fool to try. He will kill those that follow you and raise them as powerful soldiers of the Scourge. But for you, Sylvanas, his reward for you would be worse than the last.
t_text: You cannot defeat the Lich King. Not here. You would be a fool to try. He will kill those that follow you and raise them as powerful soldiers of the Scourge. But for you, Sylvanas, his reward for you would be worse than the last.

w_text: Perhaps, but know this: there must always be a Lich King. Even if you were to strike down Arthas, another would have to take his place, for without the control of the Lich King, the Scourge would wash over this world like locusts, destroying all that they touched.
t_text: Perhaps, but know this: there must always be a Lich King. Even if you were to strike down Arthas, another would have to take his place, for without the control of the Lich King, the Scourge would wash over this world like locusts, destroying all that they touched.

w_text: I do not know, Banshee Queen. I suspect that the piece of Arthas that might be left inside the Lich King is all that holds the Scourge from annihilating Azeroth.
t_text: I do not know, Banshee Queen. I suspect that the piece of Arthas that might be left inside the Lich King is all that holds the Scourge from annihilating Azeroth.

w_text: Alas, the only way to defeat the Lich King is to destroy him at the place where he was created.
t_text: Alas, the only way to defeat the Lich King is to destroy him at the place where he was created.

w_text: Aye. ARRRRRRGHHHH... He... He is coming. You... You must...
t_text: Aye. ARRRRRRGHHHH... He... He is coming. You... You must...

w_text: Halt! Do not carry that blade any further!
t_text: Halt! Do not carry that blade any further!

w_text: Do you realize what you've done?
t_text: Do you realize what you've done?

w_text: You have forged this blade from saronite, the very blood of an old god. The power of the Lich King calls to this weapon.
t_text: You have forged this blade from saronite, the very blood of an old god. The power of the Lich King calls to this weapon.

w_text: Each moment you tarry here, Quel'Delar drinks in the evil of this place.
t_text: Each moment you tarry here, Quel'Delar drinks in the evil of this place.

w_text: There is only one way to cleanse this sword. Make haste for the Sunwell and immerse the blade in its waters.
t_text: There is only one way to cleanse this sword. Make haste for the Sunwell and immerse the blade in its waters.

w_text: I can resist Frostmourne's call no more...
t_text: I can resist Frostmourne's call no more...

w_text: SILENCE, PALADIN!
t_text: SILENCE, PALADIN!

w_text: So you wish to commune with the dead? You shall have your wish.

t_text: Let us go at once.  We will track Sylvanas down.  For Gilneas!

w_text: Follow Tobias Mistmantle into the Cathedral District.
t_text: Follow Tobias Mistmantle into the Cathedral District.

w_text: Let's do our best not to be seen, $n.
t_text: Let's do our best not to be seen, $n.

w_text: Did you hear that, $n?  Sylvanas is headed to the cathedral.  Let's hurry!
t_text: Did you hear that, $n?  Sylvanas is headed to the cathedral.  Let's hurry!

w_text: Quick!  Hide in the water!
t_text: Quick!  Hide in the water!

w_text: Okay. We're going to move away from the exploding volcano and try to hook up with the orcs for the final assault on the Trade Prince. See you on the other side... I hope.
t_text: Okay. We're going to move away from the exploding volcano and try to hook up with the orcs for the final assault on the Trade Prince. See you on the other side... I hope.

w_text: You can assure Garrosh that this is a minor setback.  Our victory in Gilneas will be absolute.
t_text: You can assure Garrosh that this is a minor setback.  Our victory in Gilneas will be absolute.

w_text: You'd do well to watch your tone, General.  Neither you nor Garrosh have anything to worry about.  We've ceased all production of the Plague, as he ordered.  We'd never deploy it without his permission.
t_text: You'd do well to watch your tone, General.  Neither you nor Garrosh have anything to worry about.  We've ceased all production of the Plague, as he ordered.  We'd never deploy it without his permission.

w_text: Go with honor, General.
t_text: Go with honor, General.

w_text: What kind of question is that?  Of course we're deploying the Plague as planned!  Let the Gilneans enjoy their small victory.  Not even their bones will remain by tomorrow.
t_text: What kind of question is that?  Of course we're deploying the Plague as planned!  Let the Gilneans enjoy their small victory.  Not even their bones will remain by tomorrow.

w_text: It appears you're losing control of Gilneas, Sylvanas.  Garrosh fears he's going to have to carry out this invasion himself.
t_text: It appears you're losing control of Gilneas, Sylvanas.  Garrosh fears he's going to have to carry out this invasion himself.

w_text: You sound very confident, your Majesty.  I seriously hope you do not plan to use the Plague.  Garrosh has explicitly forbidden it.
t_text: You sound very confident, your Majesty.  I seriously hope you do not plan to use the Plague.  Garrosh has explicitly forbidden it.

w_text: I will deliver my report to our leader, then.  By your leave, my lady.
t_text: I will deliver my report to our leader, then.  By your leave, my lady.

w_text: My Lady!  Should I order my men to stop the deployment of the Plague?  Or are we to continue as planned?
t_text: My Lady!  Should I order my men to stop the deployment of the Plague?  Or are we to continue as planned?

w_text: As you wish.
t_text: As you wish!

w_text: It's time to join the fray, $n!  With you on our side the scales will surely tip in our favor!
t_text: It's time to join the fray, $n!  With you on our side the scales will surely tip in our favor!

w_text: Free at last! It is over, my son. This is the moment of reckoning.
t_text: Free at last! It is over, my son. This is the moment of reckoning.

w_text: Rise up, champions of the Light!
t_text: Rise up, champions of the Light!

w_text: What's this!?
t_text: What's this!?

w_text: He... he kept it? All this time, he kept it!?
t_text: He... he kept it? All this time, he kept it!?

w_text: I knew!
t_text: I knew!

w_text: I sensed a part of him still alive! Trapped... struggling... Oh, Arthas!
t_text: I sensed a part of him still alive! Trapped... struggling... Oh, Arthas!

w_text: Perhaps - perhaps he might someday remember what he once was.
t_text: Perhaps - perhaps he might someday remember what he once was.

w_text: By the Light, may he at last find rest, free from the icy grip of that terrible blade.
t_text: By the Light, may he at last find rest, free from the icy grip of that terrible blade.

w_text: Oh, lad...
t_text: Oh, lad...

w_text: How I miss those endless days in Lordaeron...
t_text: How I miss those endless days in Lordaeron...

w_text: ...sharpenin' yer skill with this dull blade...
t_text: ...sharpenin' yer skill with this dull blade...

w_text: ...forgin' ya into a weapon meant to withstand the demands of a great destiny.
t_text: ...forgin' ya into a weapon meant to withstand the demands of a great destiny.

w_text: Heh... Yeh sure put them skills ta use, didn't yeh, lad?
t_text: Heh... Yeh sure put them skills ta use, didn't yeh, lad?

w_text: If only I'da been able ta stop yeh that day, how different things mighta been.
t_text: If only I'da been able ta stop yeh that day, how different things mighta been.

w_text: If only I'da never discovered that accursed blade...
t_text: If only I'da never discovered that accursed blade...

w_text: Farewell, Arthas... my brother.
t_text: Farewell, Arthas... my brother.

w_text: Arthas...
t_text: Arthas...

w_text: Alas, hero of Azeroth, you give me a greater gift than you know.
t_text: Alas, hero of Azeroth, you give me a greater gift than you know.

w_text: Long have I struggled to forgive the prince for his terrible transgressions.
t_text: Long have I struggled to forgive the prince for his terrible transgressions.

w_text: My soul has been wracked with unbearable anxiety, dark thoughts... distancing me from the Light.
t_text: My soul has been wracked with unbearable anxiety, dark thoughts... distancing me from the Light.

w_text: I recall clearly the gleam of pride in his eye as he stood before me, eager to defeat the enemies of the Light...
t_text: I recall clearly the gleam of pride in his eye as he stood before me, eager to defeat the enemies of the Light...

w_text: Eager to defend his people, no matter the cost.
t_text: Eager to defend his people, no matter the cost.

w_text: It is this memory of Arthas that I choose to keep in my heart.
t_text: It is this memory of Arthas that I choose to keep in my heart.

w_text: I shall always be in your debt, friend.
t_text: I shall always be in your debt, friend.

w_text: Thank you.
t_text: Thank you.

w_text: So, it is done.
t_text: So, it is done.

w_text: I had not dared to trust my senses - too many times has the Lich King made me to be a fool.
t_text: I had not dared to trust my senses - too many times has the Lich King made me to be a fool.

w_text: Finally, he has been made to pay for the atrocities he imposed upon my people.
t_text: Finally, he has been made to pay for the atrocities he imposed upon my people.

w_text: May Azeroth never fail to remember the terrible price we paid for our weakness... for our pride.
t_text: May Azeroth never fail to remember the terrible price we paid for our weakness... for our pride.

w_text: But what now, hero? What of those freed from his grasp, but still shackled to their mortal coils?
t_text: But what now, hero? What of those freed from his grasp, but still shackled to their mortal coils?

w_text: Leave me.
t_text: Leave me.

w_text: I have much to ponder.
t_text: I have much to ponder.

w_text: Darion, my son.
t_text: Darion, my son.

w_text: At last, I am able to lay my eyes upon you again.
t_text: At last, I am able to lay my eyes upon you again.

w_text: The Lich King tormented me without end, Darion.
t_text: The Lich King tormented me without end, Darion.

w_text: Endlessly, he sought to break my will, to force me to serve him, to bind me to his blade...
t_text: Endlessly, he sought to break my will, to force me to serve him, to bind me to his blade...

w_text: Finally, when events demanded his full attention, he left me.
t_text: Finally, when events demanded his full attention, he left me.

w_text: The one memory, I clung to, Darion... The one thought that kept me from giving in...
t_text: The one memory, I clung to, Darion... The one thought that kept me from giving in...

w_text: It was your sacrifice, my son, that again saved me from eternal peril.
t_text: It was your sacrifice, my son, that again saved me from eternal peril.

w_text: Make sure everything is ready.  The orcs' emissary is ready to meet Sylvanas inside the cathedral.
t_text: Make sure everything is ready.  The orcs' emissary is ready to meet Sylvanas inside the cathedral.

w_text: The other captives are up in the volcano... they're being sacrificed, or worse, zombiefied!
t_text: The other captives are up in the volcano... they're being sacrificed, or worse, zombiefied!

w_text: I really can't thank you enough!
t_text: I really can't thank you enough!

w_text: They were trying to change me into a zombie!!!
t_text: They were trying to change me into a zombie!!!

w_text: They took the others up into the volcano. Some to turn into zombies, some to sacrifice to their turtle god, Volcanoth!
t_text: They took the others up into the volcano. Some to turn into zombies, some to sacrifice to their turtle god, Volcanoth!

w_text: $n, you gotta get in there and rescue our people!
t_text: $n, you gotta get in there and rescue our people!

t_text: Goblin zombies? The Town-In-A-Box has to be warned!

t_text: Echuta, gobin!

t_text: GOBIN!!!

w_text: Get in there and show those zombies what the Bilgewater Buccaneers are made of, kid!
t_text: Get in there and show those zombies what the Bilgewater Buccaneers are made of, kid!

w_text: You're going to love this!
t_text: You're going to love this!

t_text: We're gonna make you the ultimate footbomb uniform, kid. But first, we need parts. Lots of them.

t_text: Bagel-holes!

t_text: Doc! Help!

t_text: Crowley!  You and your elven allies are hereby ordered to serve along the king's army.  Cursed or not, you are still bound by Gilnean law!

w_text: Impossible!
t_text: Impossible!

w_text: No, old friend.  I've come to you as an equal.
t_text: No, old friend.  I've come to you as an equal.

w_text: It is decided, then.  We will unite all Gilneans and drive the Forsaken from our lands.
t_text: It is decided, then.  We will unite all Gilneans and drive the Forsaken from our lands.

w_text: Father!
t_text: Father!

w_text: You did it! We're saved!
t_text: You did it! We're saved!

w_text: BY FIRE BE PURGED!!!!
t_text: BY FIRE BE PURGED!!!!

w_text: Stay out of the way of Volcanoth's breath!
t_text: Stay out of the way of Volcanoth's breath!

w_text: All right, boss. You sure though? Just seems like a waste of good practice.
t_text: All right, boss. You sure though? Just seems like a waste of good practice.

t_text: %s cracks his knuckles.

w_text: Hang on, $n! We have to get out of here, NOW!
t_text: Hang on, $n! We have to get out of here, NOW!

w_text: I'll crush you!
t_text: I'll crush you!

w_text: Me smash! You die!
t_text: Me smash! You die!

w_text: Raaar!!! Me smash $r!
t_text: Raaar!!! Me smash $r!

t_text: %s becomes enraged!

w_text: You don't understand... I CAN'T be undead!  Not me, not now...
t_text: You don't understand... I CAN'T be undead! Not me, not now...

w_text: $n, come on! Get over here!!!
t_text: $n, come on! Get over here!!!

w_text: Don't talk back to me, troll.  You know who was left in charge here.  Haven't you stopped to ask yourself why Thrall chose me instead of you?
t_text: Don't talk back to me, troll.  You know who was left in charge here.  Haven't you stopped to ask yourself why Thrall chose me instead of you?

w_text: You are lucky that I don't gut you right here, whelp.  You are foolish to think that you can speak to your Warchief in such ways.
t_text: You are lucky that I don't gut you right here, whelp.  You are foolish to think that you can speak to your Warchief in such ways.

w_text: And what exactly do you think that you are going to do about it?  Your threats are hollow.  Go slink away with the rest of your kind to the slums, I will endure your filth in my throne room no longer.
t_text: And what exactly do you think that you are going to do about it?  Your threats are hollow.  Go slink away with the rest of your kind to the slums, I will endure your filth in my throne room no longer.

w_text: You have sealed your fate, troll.
t_text: You have sealed your fate, troll.

w_text: %s spits at Vol'jin's feet.
t_text: %s spits at Vol'jin's feet.

w_text: Vol'jin.  It's good to see you, brother.
t_text: Vol'jin.  It's good to see you, brother.

w_text: Indeed.  Someone did try to kill me, but that is not my greatest concern at this moment.  The world itself calls for my aid.
t_text: Indeed.  Someone did try to kill me, but that is not my greatest concern at this moment.  The world itself calls for my aid.

w_text: Vol'jin, I chose Garrosh because he has the strength to lead our people in these trying times.
t_text: Vol'jin, I chose Garrosh because he has the strength to lead our people in these trying times.

w_text: For all my supposed wisdom, there have been moments that I've barely been able to hold the Horde together. The Wrath Gate and Undercity displayed that clearly enough.
t_text: For all my supposed wisdom, there have been moments that I've barely been able to hold the Horde together. The Wrath Gate and Undercity displayed that clearly enough.

w_text: The Horde cries for a hero of old. An orc of true blood that will bow to no human and bear no betrayal. A warrior that will make our people proud again. Garrosh can be that hero.
t_text: The Horde cries for a hero of old. An orc of true blood that will bow to no human and bear no betrayal. A warrior that will make our people proud again. Garrosh can be that hero.

w_text: I did not make this decision lightly, Vol'jin. I know our alliances will suffer for it. I know the Horde will be irreversibly changed. But I made this choice with confidence that Garrosh is exactly what the Horde needs.
t_text: I did not make this decision lightly, Vol'jin. I know our alliances will suffer for it. I know the Horde will be irreversibly changed. But I made this choice with confidence that Garrosh is exactly what the Horde needs.

w_text: I'm trusting you and the other leaders to not let this divide our people. You are stronger than that.
t_text: I'm trusting you and the other leaders to not let this divide our people. You are stronger than that.

w_text: Throm'ka, old friend.
t_text: Throm'ka, old friend.

w_text: You deserve to lose this land, for what your people did to us!  Now back off, or face the wrath of the worgen!
t_text: You deserve to lose this land, for what you people did to us! Now back off, or face the wrath of the worgen!

w_text: Dere be no question why, Garrosh.  He gave ya tha title because ya be Grom's son and because tha people be wantin' a war hero.
t_text: Dere be no question why, Garrosh.  He gave ya tha title because ya be Grom's son and because tha people be wantin' a war hero.

w_text: I tink ya be even more like ya father den ya thought, even witout da demon blood.
t_text: I tink ya be even more like ya father den ya thought, even witout da demon blood.

w_text: Ya be no Warchief of mine.  Ya not earned my respect and I'll not be seein' tha Horde destroyed by ya foolish thirst for war.
t_text: Ya be no Warchief of mine.  Ya not earned my respect and I'll not be seein' tha Horde destroyed by ya foolish thirst for war.

w_text: I know exactly what I'll be doin' about it, son of Hellscream.  I'll watch and wait as ya people slowly become aware of ya ineptitude.  I'll laugh as dey grow ta despise ya as I do.
t_text: I know exactly what I'll be doin' about it, son of Hellscream.  I'll watch and wait as ya people slowly become aware of ya ineptitude.  I'll laugh as dey grow ta despise ya as I do.

w_text: And when tha time comes dat ya failure is complete and ya "power" is meaningless, I will be dere to end ya rule swiftly and silently.
t_text: And when tha time comes dat ya failure is complete and ya "power" is meaningless, I will be dere to end ya rule swiftly and silently.

w_text: Ya will spend ya reign glancin' over ya shoulda and fearin' tha shadows, for when tha time comes and ya blood be slowly drainin' out, ya will know exactly who fired tha arrow dat pierced ya black heart.
t_text: Ya will spend ya reign glancin' over ya shoulda and fearin' tha shadows, for when tha time comes and ya blood be slowly drainin' out, ya will know exactly who fired tha arrow dat pierced ya black heart.

w_text: And you yours, "Warchief."
t_text: And you yours, "Warchief."

w_text: I have sometin' to show ya. It be easier to understand if ya see it yourself.
t_text: I have sometin' to show ya. It be easier to understand if ya see it yourself.

w_text: Tha Darkspear are 'ere because I led dem here.  Orgrimmar be no home as long as it be under Hellscream's hand.
t_text: Tha Darkspear are 'ere because I led dem here.  Orgrimmar be no home as long as it be under Hellscream's hand.

w_text: Still, I fear I was lettin' my temper drive me ta bein' rash. Thrall devoted himself to makin' the Horde what it is, so I've no eagerness to be leavin' it on a whim.  Dis will be needin' much more thought.
t_text: Still, I fear I was lettin' my temper drive me ta bein' rash. Thrall devoted himself to makin' the Horde what it is, so I've no eagerness to be leavin' it on a whim.  Dis will be needin' much more thought.

w_text: But dese be worries for older minds.  Ya still have much to learn.  Go help tha people of tha Darkspear.  I am sure we'll be speakin' again real soon.
t_text: But dese be worries for older minds.  Ya still have much to learn.  Go help tha people of tha Darkspear.  I am sure we'll be speakin' again real soon.

w_text: Tha Sea Witch is dead, our home is reclaimed, but our future still be uncertain.
t_text: Tha Sea Witch is dead, our home is reclaimed, but our future still be uncertain.

w_text: I've no love for Garrosh, dat much is sure, but leavin' tha Horde is not a decision I be takin' lightly.
t_text: I've no love for Garrosh, dat much is sure, but leavin' tha Horde is not a decision I be takin' lightly.

w_text: Dere's only one with tha answers I seek. Ya can stay and watch if ya like.
t_text: Dere's only one with tha answers I seek. Ya can stay and watch if ya like.

w_text: Thrall!  I am glad ya be well.  Dere were rumors otherwise.
t_text: Thrall!  I am glad ya be well.  Dere were rumors otherwise.

w_text: I must beg ya council, my friend.  I can't be standin' by Garrosh while he be turnin' our people against each other for tha sake of war.  My respect for you does not extend to dis new Horde... I am tinkin' of leadin' my people away.
t_text: I must beg ya council, my friend.  I can't be standin' by Garrosh while he be turnin' our people against each other for tha sake of war.  My respect for you does not extend to dis new Horde... I am tinkin' of leadin' my people away.

w_text: I understand, brotha. I will tink on this and be troublin' ya no furtha. You have a world to be savin'.
t_text: I understand, brotha. I will tink on this and be troublin' ya no furtha. You have a world to be savin'.

w_text: Ya be strong and proud, youngblood.  Tha Darkspear will be honored ta have you fight beside d'em.
t_text: Ya be strong and proud, youngblood.  Tha Darkspear will be honored ta have you fight beside d'em.

w_text: Dese be dark times, but our people will be stayin' with tha Horde for tha good of all.
t_text: Dese be dark times, but our people will be stayin' with tha Horde for tha good of all.

w_text: Thrall's words be true. Dey always be. The Horde is much more den a few old, stubborn leaders and a handful of heroes from Northrend. The people be cryin' Garrosh's name... at least for now.
t_text: Thrall's words be true. Dey always be. The Horde is much more den a few old, stubborn leaders and a handful of heroes from Northrend. The people be cryin' Garrosh's name... at least for now.

w_text: Still, I be hopin' Thrall will return to us one day. Tha future right now be lookin' very grim... and very bloody.
t_text: Still, I be hopin' Thrall will return to us one day. Tha future right now be lookin' very grim... and very bloody.

w_text: Go now. Make tha Darkspear proud. Dere are many wars ahead of us, an' I'm sure ya be havin' a part to play in all of dem.
t_text: Go now. Make tha Darkspear proud. Dere are many wars ahead of us, an' I'm sure ya be havin' a part to play in all of dem.

w_text: What's going on here?
t_text: What's going on here?

w_text: Wait, am I... home?
t_text: Wait, am I... home?

w_text: You people... what are you doing here?  Why are you in my house?
t_text: You people... what are you doing here? Why are you in my house?

w_text: Mother... father... Thurman... where are you?  Come help me!
t_text: Mother... father... Thurman... where are you?

w_text: No... I remember.  My family is dead.  And so am I.
t_text: No... I remember. My family is dead. And so am I.

w_text: And my soul... my soul belongs to the Scourge!
t_text: And my soul.... my soul belongs to the Scourge!

w_text: DIE, YOU WRETCHES!
t_text: DIE, YOU WRETCHES!

w_text: We'll grant you a swift death, Arthas. More than can be said for the thousands you've tortured and slain.
t_text: We'll grant you a swift death, Arthas. More than can be said for the thousands you've tortured and slain.

w_text: So be it. Champions, attack!
t_text: So be it. Champions, attack!

w_text: LIGHT GRANT ME ONE FINAL BLESSING! GIVE ME THE STRENGTH... TO SHATTER THESE BONDS!
t_text: LIGHT GRANT ME ONE FINAL BLESSING! GIVE ME THE STRENGTH... TO SHATTER THESE BONDS!

w_text: No more, Arthas! No more lives will be consumed by your hatred!
t_text: No more, Arthas! No more lives will be consumed by your hatred!

w_text: Yes, my... wait, be quiet!  I hear the lieutenant approaching.
t_text: Yes, my... wait, be quiet! I hear the lieutenant approaching.

w_text: Gebler, you came!  What did he say?
t_text: Gebler, you came! What did he say?

w_text: What?  NO!  This can't be!  Gebler, you know me... we were friends once!
t_text: What? NO! This can't be! Gebler, you know me... we were friends once!

w_text: Gebler, father, why would you...
t_text: Gebler, father, why would you...

w_text: The world of the living may have turned its back on me, but I'm no damned Scourge.  Just go.
t_text: The world of the living may have turned its back on me, but I'm no damned Scourge. Just go.

w_text: The time has come, my little captive... word has come back from your father.
t_text: The time has come, my little captive... word has come back from your father.

w_text: High Priest Voss denounces you as a daughter.  He's ordered that you be executed immediately.
t_text: High Priest Voss denounces you as a daughter. He's ordered that you be executed immediately.

w_text: The High Priest sends his regrets.  He had hoped that one day you would be a powerful weapon against our enemies.
t_text: The High Priest sends his regrets. He had hoped that one day you would be a powerful weapon against our enemies.

w_text: Unfortunately, you were too dangerous in life, and you're far too dangerous in undeath.  I will enjoy killing you, you Scourged witch...
t_text: Unfortunately, you were too dangerous in life, and you're far too dangerous in undeath. I will enjoy killing you, you Scourged witch...

t_text: Monsters! Monsters come to take our gold!

t_text: Kill the pig! Spill it's blood!

t_text: Father!

w_text: Shut up.

t_text: You raised me to be a killer.  How am I doing, daddy?

t_text: But wait... I remember now. You taught me to only kill the undead. So you do want me to kill myself, daddy?

w_text: Then again, why kill myself... when I can kill YOU instead!
t_text: Then again, why kill myself... when I can kill YOU instead!

w_text: They seek only power, as the Twilight do.  Yet you are confident that they will not turn on us.  Did I raise you to be fools?

w_text: They slaughtered stone troggs, Gorik?  This is supposed to sway me?  It is not much of a feat.
t_text: They slaughtered stone troggs, Gorik?  This is supposed to sway me?  It is not much of a feat.

w_text: What of you Boden?  What do you see in this "champion?"
t_text: What of you Boden?  What do you see in this "champion?"

w_text: That very well may be.  Even fools have uses though.  I keep you around after all.
t_text: That very well may be.  Even fools have uses though.  I keep you around after all.

w_text: And so the "champion" arrives.
t_text: And so the "champion" arrives.

w_text: So small.  So soft.  It's a wonder you've even lasted this long down here, fleshling.
t_text: So small.  So soft.  It's a wonder you've even lasted this long down here, fleshling.

w_text: Or perhaps a testament to your abilities?
t_text: Or perhaps a testament to your abilities?

w_text: All of this for a piece of the World Pillar?  What exactly, shaman, do you intend to do with it?
t_text: All of this for a piece of the World Pillar?  What exactly, shaman, do you intend to do with it?

w_text: And what then? Will you leave Deepholm to its denizens?
t_text: And what then? Will you leave Deepholm to its denizens?

w_text: I'm glad you're at least that perceptive.
t_text: I'm glad you're at least that perceptive.

w_text: I propose this: We will march on the Twilight cult and extinguish any utterings of Deathwing's name from this realm.  Your Earthen Ring will march with us.
t_text: I propose this: We will march on the Twilight cult and extinguish any utterings of Deathwing's name from this realm.  Your Earthen Ring will march with us.

w_text: You do this, and I will send Gorsik to the temple with our piece of the World Pillar.
t_text: You do this, and I will send Gorsik to the temple with our piece of the World Pillar.

w_text: Seal the rift and leave this place.
t_text: Seal the rift and leave this place.

w_text: Save your thanks.  We march upon the Twilight Precipice as soon as our forces are gathered. I expect to see you on the battlefield.
t_text: Save your thanks.  We march upon the Twilight Precipice as soon as our forces are gathered. I expect to see you on the battlefield.

w_text: Speak with Terrath the Steady when you are ready to begin.
t_text: Speak with Terrath the Steady when you are ready to begin.

w_text: Be swift, $c. The stone dragons will not give up easily.
t_text: Be swift, $c. The stone dragons will not give up easily.

w_text: You've strayed too far from the Stonemother's gaze, dragon.  It is time that you be put in your place.
t_text: You've strayed too far from the Stonemother's gaze, dragon.  It is time that you be put in your place.

w_text: Jump from rock to rock to attract the attention of the Broodmother!
t_text: Jump from rock to rock to attract the attention of the Broodmother!

w_text: She submits.  Well done, fleshling.
t_text: She submits.  Well done, fleshling.

w_text: This champion also faced the Stone Dragons and their Broodmother with no glimpse of fear or hesitation.  I've seen the most hardy of giants falter where the fleshling did not.
t_text: This champion also faced the Stone Dragons and their Broodmother with no glimpse of fear or hesitation.  I've seen the most hardy of giants falter where the fleshling did not.

w_text: Not wasted, Stonemother.  It has been very useful.
t_text: Not wasted, Stonemother.  It has been very useful.

w_text: It stands to reason that it may be here for exactly the reasons it says it is.
t_text: It stands to reason that it may be here for exactly the reasons it says it is.

w_text: You still have much to prove.  But you brought the stone.  That is an excellent start.
t_text: You still have much to prove.  But you brought the stone.  That is an excellent start.

w_text: The other Stone Lords have already heard my words.
t_text: The other Stone Lords have already heard my words.

w_text: They should show you a degree of trust.
t_text: They should show you a degree of trust.

w_text: At least enough so that you can prove yourself.
t_text: At least enough so that you can prove yourself.

w_text: You've come to prove yourself, fleshling?  The Crumbling Depths lie northeast.  The stone you seek is within.
t_text: You've come to prove yourself, fleshling?  The Crumbling Depths lie northeast.  The stone you seek is within.

w_text: I've not spoken with the strangers, but I bore witness to their champion treading deep into the Crumbling Depths and returning unscathed.  It is clearly capable.
t_text: I've not spoken with the strangers, but I bore witness to their champion treading deep into the Crumbling Depths and returning unscathed.  It is clearly capable.

w_text: Hah! Did you mistake me for Diamant, $r? Or perhaps some other whimpering, compliant stone trogg who cares?
t_text: Hah! Did you mistake me for Diamant, $r? Or perhaps some other whimpering, compliant stone trogg who cares?

w_text: If you seek peace, relinquish the World Pillar and leave Deepholm. This is our realm. Your only welcome here shall be found underneath my stone foot.
t_text: If you seek peace, relinquish the World Pillar and leave Deepholm. This is our realm. Your only welcome here shall be found underneath my stone foot.

w_text: It's not bravery that drives it.  It strode before me like it thought this place its home. It is a fool.  It will surely get itself killed soon enough.
t_text: It's not bravery that drives it.  It strode before me like it thought this place its home. It is a fool.  It will surely get itself killed soon enough.

w_text: I have no love for the intruders, Stonemother, but these fleshlings went well out of their way to cleanse the filth from the Crimson Expanse.

t_text: So Glubtok have two choices: die or be rich and powerful?

t_text: You. No. Take. CANDLE!

w_text: I mold you now!
t_text: I mold you now!

w_text: I make you candle!
t_text: I make you candle!

w_text: Wax and ruin!
t_text: Wax and ruin!

t_text: |TInterface\Icons\INV_Shadowflames_Wave:20|t%s targets you with |cFFFF0000|Hspell:421282|h[Darkflame Pickaxe]|h|r!

w_text: This why I king and you dead.
t_text: This why I king and you dead.

w_text: You die!
t_text: You die!

w_text: Snuffed out!
t_text: Snuffed out!

w_text: Weaklings!
t_text: Weaklings!

w_text: But I... the king...
t_text: But I... the king...

w_text: Intruders approaching. Systems on.
t_text: Intruders approaching. Systems on.

w_text: Activating defense protocols.
t_text: Activating defense protocols.

w_text: Seismic protocol activated.
t_text: Seismic protocol activated.

w_text: Offensive measures engaged.
t_text: Offensive measures engaged.

w_text: Dominant intruder identified.
t_text: Dominant intruder identified.

t_text: |TInterface\ICONS\INV_ElementalEarth2.blp:20|t %s begins to cast |cFFFF0000|Hspell:424888|h[Seismic Smash]|h|r.

w_text: Engaging offensive protocols.
t_text: Engaging offensive protocols.

w_text: Intruder terminated.
t_text: Intruder terminated.

w_text: All intruders terminated.
t_text: All intruders terminated.

w_text: All systems... shutting down...
t_text: All systems... shutting down...

w_text: Not us. Must kill.
t_text: Not us. Must kill.

w_text: To dust.
t_text: To dust.

w_text: Shattered.
t_text: Shattered.

w_text: Crushed.
t_text: Crushed.

w_text: Fortify!
t_text: Fortify!

w_text: Lay waste!
t_text: Lay waste!

w_text: Destroyed. All.
t_text: Destroyed. All.

w_text: Return... to nothing...
t_text: Return... to nothing...

w_text: Come! Let us speak.
t_text: Come! Let us speak.

w_text: Bow before me!
t_text: Bow before me!

w_text: Bend the knee!
t_text: Bend the knee!

w_text: We revel in your fear!
t_text: We revel in your fear!

w_text: Your terror is our victory!
t_text: Your terror is our victory!

w_text: We rise through conquest!
t_text: We rise through conquest!

w_text: Azj-Kahet will thrive!
t_text: Azj-Kahet will thrive!

w_text: Should have listened.
t_text: Should have listened.

w_text: Blessed silence.
t_text: Blessed silence.

w_text: I shall prepare your eulogy myself.
t_text: I shall prepare your eulogy myself.

w_text: My... beautiful... voice...
t_text: My... beautiful... voice...

w_text: This is the Deephaul Ravine, where we harvest precious materials. Your task is to secure as many of them as possible before Ruffious does the same.
t_text: This is the Deephaul Ravine, where we harvest precious materials. Your task is to secure as many of them as possible before Ruffious does the same.

w_text: Focus your attention on escorting the mine carts and on seizing the crystal in the center of the mine. Failure is not an option.
t_text: Focus your attention on escorting the mine carts and on seizing the crystal in the center of the mine. Failure is not an option.

w_text: A crystal has formed deep within the mine. Seize it before Ruffious does!
t_text: A crystal has formed deep within the mine. Seize it before Ruffious does!

w_text: One of our carts is leaving the station. Do not let it fall Ruffious's clutches!
t_text: One of our carts is leaving the station. Do not let it fall into Ruffious's clutches!

w_text: Ruffious's lackeys have loaded up a cart. Take control of it and siphon its contents!
t_text: Ruffious's lackeys have loaded up a cart. Take control of it and siphon its contents!

w_text: The Unbound will surely waste such precious materials. At least we are not leaving empty handed.
t_text: The Unbound will surely waste such precious materials. At least we are not leaving empty handed.

w_text: An admirable performance. The Machine Speakers will put these materials to good use.
t_text: An admirable performance. The Machine Speakers will put these materials to good use.

w_text: Welcome to the Deephaul Ravine, friends! Our job today: gather as many minerals and gems as we can carry, before Uzjax gets to them.
t_text: Welcome to the Deephaul Ravine, friends! Our job today: gather as many minerals and gems as we can carry, before Uzjax gets to them.

w_text: To do that, you'll have to stick close to the mine carts and grab hold of the shiny crystal in the center of the tracks. Let's get to it!
t_text: To do that, you'll have to stick close to the mine carts and grab hold of the shiny crystal in the center of the tracks. Let's get to it!

w_text: I see a crystal down in the mines! Grab it before Uzjax gets to it!
t_text: I see a crystal down in the mines! Grab it before Uzjax gets to it!

w_text: Uzjax has a cart leaving his quarry. I say we take it for ourselves!
t_text: Uzjax has a cart leaving his quarry. I say we take it for ourselves!

w_text: One of our carts is loaded up! Make sure that it reaches its destination!
t_text: One of our carts is loaded up! Make sure that it reaches its destination!

w_text: Well, it's not the best haul I've ever seen. But it will do. Thanks for the hard work.
t_text: Well, it's not the best haul I've ever seen. But it will do. Thanks for the hard work.

w_text: Nice work! With a haul like this, we'll be able to make all sorts of repairs around Khaz Algar.
t_text: Nice work! With a haul like this, we'll be able to make all sorts of repairs around Khaz Algar.

w_text: Over here!
t_text: Over here!

w_text: See you up top.
t_text: See you up top.

w_text: Cogs bless you. I must inform the Foreman on what's happening.
t_text: Cogs bless you. I must inform the Foreman on what's happening.

w_text: Clear the path for me! I'll see you closer to the entrance to discuss how to shut this operation down.
t_text: Clear the path for me! I'll see you closer to the entrance to discuss how to shut this operation down.

w_text: For The Queen!
t_text: For The Queen!

w_text: All... Our... Plans...
t_text: All... Our... Plans...

w_text: What could the nerubians have wanted?
t_text: What could the nerubians have wanted?

w_text: They stole my opals!
t_text: They stole my opals!

w_text: Nerubians thought they could stop me!
t_text: Nerubians thought they could stop me!

w_text: My precious opal!
t_text: My precious opal!

w_text: I'd better get back to it...
t_text: I'd better get back to it...

w_text: Thank you, $c. I will not forget this.
t_text: Thank you, $c. I will not forget this.

w_text: Thank you for working to restore the mine.
t_text: Thank you for working to restore the mine.

w_text: Cogs bless you.
t_text: Cogs bless you.

w_text: He he he he. Look how tough all of you look. This is gonna be good!
t_text: He he he he. Look how tough all of you look. This is gonna be good!

w_text: Get ready. It's about to go down!
t_text: Get ready. It's about to go down!

w_text: Ah, c'mon. Right when it was gettin' good!
t_text: Ah, c'mon. Right when it was gettin' good!

w_text: This is a gen-u-ine nailbiter!
t_text: This is a gen-u-ine nailbiter!

w_text: Aw, you keep spoilin' all my fun!
t_text: Aw, you keep spoilin' all my fun!

w_text: Keepin' this fight interestin' this time!
t_text: Keepin' this fight interestin' this time!

w_text: That's gotta hurt. But not for long. Heh.
t_text: That's gotta hurt. But not for long. Heh.

w_text: Wowza. I'm gonna remember that one for a long time.
t_text: Wowza. I'm gonna remember that one for a long time.

w_text: Oof, right in the... well, the everywhere!
t_text: Oof, right in the... well, the everywhere!

w_text: Would you be interested in filling out a satisfaction survey about your interaction today?
t_text: Would you be interested in filling out a satisfaction survey about your interaction today?

w_text: It's about time!
t_text: It's about time!

w_text: Let's make an example of you.
t_text: Let's make an example of you.

w_text: Flee the flame!
t_text: Flee the flame!

w_text: Fear the fel!
t_text: Fear the fel!

w_text: Learn your place!
t_text: Learn your place!

w_text: Back, you mongrels!
t_text: Back, you mongrels!

w_text: Naughty little Nibbles!
t_text: Naughty little Nibbles!

w_text: Nibbles! Drop it!
t_text: Nibbles! Drop it!

w_text: Ahh, just what I needed.
t_text: Ahh, just what I needed.

w_text: Nibbles, give mother a taste!
t_text: Nibbles, give mother a taste!

w_text: But... my... magic...
t_text: But... my... magic...

w_text: Fel conquers all.
t_text: Fel conquers all.

t_text: |TInterface\ICONS\Spell_Paladin_Lightofdawn.blp:20|t %s casts |cFFFF0000|Hspell:1230304|h[Light Infusion]|h|r at Kystia!

t_text: |TInterface\ICONS\Spell_Fire_FelFlameBreath.blp:20|t %s begins casting |cFFFF0000|Hspell:1253811|h[Fel Spray]|h|r!

t_text: %s makes her escape.

w_text: Be careful! It's trying to draw you in!

w_text: Yea, yea. We know! We know!
t_text: Yea, yea. We know! We know!

w_text: Finally, some excitement!
t_text: Finally, some excitement!

w_text: Well, what are you waiting for?
t_text: Well, what are you waiting for?

w_text: Let's get moving!
t_text: Let's get moving!

w_text: Aw, I was just getting warmed up too.
t_text: Aw, I was just getting warmed up too.

w_text: Fine, but those were my kills! No taking credit.
t_text: Fine, but those were my kills! No taking credit.

w_text: Please stop! I didn't realize who you were! Ve'nari has arrived. She's waiting for you.
t_text: Please stop! I didn't realize who you were! Ve'nari has arrived. She's waiting for you.

w_text: Xal'atath has a dark and glorious purpose for you, $c!
t_text: Xal'atath has a dark and glorious purpose for you, $c!

w_text: The Twilight's Blade embraces the end. Join us!
t_text: The Twilight's Blade embraces the end. Join us!

w_text: Bah. Your investigation ends here!
t_text: Bah. Your investigation ends here!

w_text: This is the last you'll speak of it!
t_text: This is the last you'll speak of it!

w_text: We are Xal'atath's finest weapon!
t_text: We are Xal'atath's finest weapon!

w_text: The apocalypse beckons. We answer her call.
t_text: The apocalypse beckons. We answer her call.

w_text: I have no interest in doomsday events, $c.
t_text: I have no interest in doomsday events, $c.

w_text: Do you have ambitions? Desires? I might know the way to achieving them...
t_text: Do you have ambitions? Desires? I might know the way to achieving them...

w_text: Do I give the impression I'm part of that cult? I need to rethink my wardrobe...
t_text: Do I give the impression I'm part of that cult? I need to rethink my wardrobe...

w_text: The Twilight's Blade? That sounds dreadful. I'll keep an eye out.
t_text: The Twilight's Blade? That sounds dreadful. I'll keep an eye out.

w_text: Are there cultists in the city? I had better hurry home...
t_text: Are there cultists in the city? I had better hurry home...

w_text: Over here, $p. The rumors I mentioned began in this part of the city.
t_text: Over here, $p. The rumors I mentioned began in this part of the city.

w_text: Push them back!
t_text: Push them back!

w_text: Welcome to our humble place of business, traveler.
t_text: It's unfortunate that affairs have come to this, but what are we going to do? Wait for them to come slaughter us in our sleep and go out of business?
